notes.title: Announcement Regarding Compensation for the Ghieva Coin Event Shop Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the issue where only one item was received upon purchasing the [Gear Summon Ticket Selection Chest] from the Ghieva Coin Event Shop.

This issue, which occurred prior to the temporary maintenance on May 9 (Fri), has since been resolved.


As of today, compensation has been delivered to Rune Hunters who purchased the Equipment Summon Selection Box during the affected period.

Please see below for more details.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[ Announcement Regarding Compensation for the Ghieva Coin Event Shop Issue ]

- Compensation Eligibility:
Rune Hunters who purchased the [Gear Summon Ticket Selection Chest] from the Ghieva Coin Event Shop between the maintenance on May 8 (Thu) and the issue fix on May 9 (Thu).

- Compensation Item: 9 Gear Summon Ticket Selection Chests will be provided for each purchase record

- Compensation Period: May 9(Fri), 2025 16:00 (UTC+9)

※ Rewards are sent to your mailbox, and you must obtain your compensation directly.
※ The event reward will be sent via mail once per account for both modes, and the mail will be stored for 30 days (720 hours).
 └ You can only obtain the reward from either Standard or Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope that the details on known issues will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.



Thank you.

tags.bug: This issue, which occurred prior to the temporary maintenance on May 9 (Fri), has since been resolved.

notes.title: Issue Regarding Payment In In-Game Paid Shop on iOS
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Issue where prices of certain packages for certain currencies in the Paid Shop were set higher than the intended prices on the Apple App Store has been found.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the issue, and please see below for the affected products and the measures taken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]Issue Regarding Payment In In-Game Paid Shop on iOS[/b]

[b]■ Affected Product List[/b]
- Lunar New Year Essence Package
- Lunar New Year Charm Essence Package

[b]■ Affected Currencies[/b]
- USD, VND, PHP, RUB

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Additional Distribution of Diamonds[/b]
- For purchasers of the concerned products, additional Diamonds equivalent to the difference between the incorrect price and the correct price will be given.
  ● Lunar New Year Essence Package: Additional 222 Diamonds (Paid 215, Free 7)
  ● Lunar New Year Charm Essence Package: Additional 222 Diamonds (Paid 215, Free 7)
※ These Diamonds will not be sent via mail but will be added to the Diamonds you own.
※ This measure will not be applied to accounts to which the refund is given.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Inquiry[/b]
- If you have any further inquiries regarding the purchased products, please contact Support via the link below.

[url=https://cs.line.games/][Go to Support][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We apologize again for the inconvenience this issue caused.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Statue Level Up Pass
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
　
In celebration of UNDECEMBER's Season 'Trials of Power', the Statue Level Up Pass is now available to purchase!
　
Play the game with the Statue Level Up Pass to get significant help for your journey!
You can view the Statue Level Up Pass by pressing the [Event] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
　
Please see below for more details on the Statue Level Up Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ Statue Level Up Pass 
The Statue Level Up Pass, which is a product where you can claim rewards every time you level up the Chaos Statue, has been released.
　
■ Statue Level Up Pass Period 
- After the Nov. 9 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the next Season update
　
■ What is the Statue Level Up Pass?
- Level up the Chaos Statue to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.
- Statue Level Up Pass rewards start from Lv. 1 and go up to Lv. 20, increasing by increments of 1 level.
- You can purchase the Statue Level Up Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Playing in Season Normal Mode will not affect your Pass in Season Hardcore Mode.
　
■ Statue Level Up Pass Rewards
- Statue Level Up Pass Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Statue Level Up Pass and reaching the required Chaos Statue levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d50602ef734c35dc2ef140cb9e95927f92ccff75.png[/img]
※ Items and Gear that can be obtained from [Exclusive] chests are untradeable.

■ To Note
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ The Statue Level Up Pass can only be purchased once the game's Chaos Dungeon content has been unlocked.
※ Please ensure that you claim any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.
※ You can only claim Statue Level Up Pass rewards if you purchase the Pass.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience tremendous benefits with the Statue Level Up Pass!
　
Thank you.

notes.title: New/Returning User Attendance Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  
In celebration of UNDECEMBER's Season Trials of Power, we have prepared the New/Returning User Attendance Event.
  
Participate in the attendance event that will greatly assist you in a new beginning! 　
You can view the New/Returning User Attendance Event by pressing the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
  
Please see below for more details on the New/Returning User Attendance Event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ New/Returning User Attendance Event
The New/Returning User Attendance event, which offers rewards every day for 28 days, will be added for new and returning Rune Hunters.
  
■ New/Returning User Attendance Event Period
- After the Jan. 9 (Thu) 2025 maintenance - Until before the next Season update
  
■ What is the New/Returning User Attendance Event?
- The New/Returning User Attendance event grants rewards for a total of 28 days and will be available for only one season.
- The New/Returning User Attendance event can run simultaneously with the regular attendance event.
- The New/Returning User Attendance will be integrated across accounts without distinguishing between Standard and Season.
  
■ How to Participate 
- You can participate via the screen that appears by clicking the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
- You can obtain the activated rewards by clicking the [Receive Reward] button.
  
■ New/Returning User Attendance Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dc995657034d11ab5ec70032fd15124310ab2633.png[/img]

■ To Note 
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ The attendance information is refreshed every day at 9:00 (UTC+9). 
※ You must obtain your rewards directly yourself, and obtained rewards will be sent to your bag.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the period ends.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ Rune Hunters who create their accounts and log in for the first time during the event period will be considered new users.
※ If your last login date is more than 30 days prior to the start date of the corresponding attendance event, you will be considered a returning user.
※ The New/Returning status will be maintained until the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance event ends.
※ The New/Returning status will only apply to the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jan. 9 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jan. 9 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season Re:Birth,
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 'Trials of Power' update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Auction House Suspension Measures

◆ Auction House Suspension Measures
After Jan. 6 (Mon) 2024, 11:00 (UTC+9), you will no longer be able to register new items at the Trading Post and Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

◈ Content Reset

◆ Season Mode Chaos Statue Information
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Chaos Compendium Score and Statue Level in the Season mode will be integrated to the higher one between the Season mode and Standard Mode.
※ The Chaos Statue of the Standard Mode will not be reset.
※ Even after the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Chaos Cards, Traces of Memory, Exodium Cards, and Chaos Key and chests containing them will remain.


◆ Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring of the Chaos Statue will be reset.
※ Upon reset, equipment information of Chaos Rune Cast, Chaos Runes owned in Storage and Bag, and Chest items containing Chaos Runes will be deleted.

If you have any unclaimed rewards saved in the Chaos Ring, please claim them before the maintenance.


◆ Black Market Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Black Market's Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate's Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season Trials of Power maintenance.


◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, 
will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character's Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, 
as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.


◆ Constellation of Time Reset
After the Jan. 8 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.


◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.

You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.


◆ Solo Descent Raids Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Solo Descent Raids information will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Raid you are playing before the update.


◆ Mastery Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.


◆ Rune Master Points Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.


◆ Offering System Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Offering Mission progress and used Offering Points will be reset.

Offering Points from the previous season will be added up and will be able to be used in the new season.
※ Offering Points obtained during the Season Re:Birth remains until the Season Trials of Power.


◆ God's Blessing / Character Traits Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your God's Blessing and Character Traits will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset God's Blessing and Character Traits.

◈ Balance and Content Adjustments

◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, certain Runes' effects will be changed.


◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes
- With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.


◆ Improvements to Zodiac Nodes
- The effect of the 'Acid Manipulator' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- A new effect of the 'Enlargement' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- Certain effects of the Specialization Zodiac Cosmos Node will be improved.
- Steel, Sadness, Torch, and Tipan Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Hammer, Wrath, Bonfire, and Flame Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Darkness, Stra, Fisherman, and Sailboat Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Brilliance, Vacuum, Waterfall, and Pirate Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Dawn, Hail, Monsoon, and Sympathy Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Respiration, Corpse, Wisp, and Executioner Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.


◆ Improvements to Gear Options
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, elements of certain Legendary and Ancient options that do not fit their concepts will be adjusted.


◆ Change of Item Stacks
The maximum stacks of certain consumable items will be adjusted.


◆ Improvement of Stat Calculation
The formula of the Movement Speed stat will be improved.


◆ Change of the Rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue Registration
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue registration will be changed.

◈ Information on the End of Re:Birth

◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season Re:Birth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fff6602b3aa635dcd25a96910b848885ce021512.png[/img]

◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season Re:Birth
- The items in your Season Character's Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character's Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character's Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character's Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.


◆ To note
※ Items stored in the Standard Mode Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot during the Season Re:Birth will be removed after the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance and cannot be restored.
 └ If you have any items in the Temporary Storage or Temporary Slot, please obtain them before the beginning of the new season.
※ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance.
※ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

※ The information may change when the update takes place.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
 We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season Trials of Power.

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 16
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
I'm Seong Seop Song, the director of UNDECEMBER.

We are already halfway through the Season Re:Birth since it is a short-term season.

I would like to start this Director’s Letter by saying that we look forward to your continuous support for UNDECEMBER at the end of this year as well.

As many of you already know, there was a Q&A session with two YouTube streamers,
where we received many honest opinions about the game, from the suggestions for game improvements and some tough questions that were harder to answer.

To address those questions, we would like to give you an insight into the direction of development through this Director’s Letter.


1. Season System

The most common feedback we’ve received concerns the future of the season system, and we understand there have been a lot of concerns around it.
To give you a direct answer, UNDECEMBER will be reinforcing the season system from now on.
We will implement growth support buffs that are at or above the level of those applied in the Season Re:Birth so that new and returning Rune Hunters can easily adapt to the game, 
and make several changes including increasing drop rates, decreasing the amount of consumed currencies, and holding various events to make sure that more Rune Hunters can enjoy the endgame content during each season.
The changes will also include setting the chance of the newly added season content to occur at 100%, and applying discounts on Chaos Stone costs to play the content of previous seasons.
Lastly, we will change the reset rule of the Chaos Statue so that players of Standard Mode do not have to go through the inconvenience of raising the Statue Level again.

2. Drop Rate

Next, we heard a lot of thoughts on the low drop chances.
While low drop rates bore the gameplay by making players lose hopes of obtaining desired items,
frequent drops of items that are designed to be rare can diminish their value.
We have been working on a solution to address both of these problems at the same time, and we will make improvements as below.

Simply increasing the drop rates can only be noticeable by Rune Hunters at higher stages who have access to certain content,
so we will avoid directly increasing relatively lower drop rates but diversify the sources of these items.

In addition, we will significantly reduce the prices in the Disassemble Shop, allowing all Rune Hunters to obtain reasonable rewards that are in line with their playtime,
and rebalance the drop system so that certain Gear and Essences, which were previously dropped from higher difficulty content, will also be dropped from the lower difficulty content.

Moreover, we plan to hold more events for Rune Hunters, such as the Holiday Raid Event, to provide additional opportunities for obtaining more items,
so that more Rune Hunters can experience the fun of obtaining better loot.

3. Balance Changes

UNDECEMBER’s skill balance patches are not intended to only lower stats,
but rather to first adjust skills that are rarely used to make as various skills as possible used,
and only to lower the stats of skills that harm the overall game balance due to its overpowering stats.

Of course, we are aware that the ideal solution is to avoid making a skill that harms the balances in the first place, and the development team will review the balance more thoroughly to do so.

4. Content Improvements

Many of you expressed concerns regarding the content that was introduced to refresh the game but has now lost its appeal.
We will make improvements to content according to the order of priority as stated below.

1) Improvements to the Constellation of Time

We heard many complaints regarding the Constellation of Time, even that it needs to be removed from the game.
The development team has considered several options from revamping the content to removing it, but has concluded that it cannot be removed since there are several related content.
Therefore, we have concluded instead that we will increase the Emotion and Gold drops drastically so that it has more fruits to play the Constellation of Time.
We will make sure that old content is not neglected in the future.

2) Improvements to the Solo Raids
Solo Raid is a content that has been avoided by the players due to its discouraging rewards and difficulty unlike its designed intention.
In the next season, we will increase the rewards and lower the boss difficulty.
Plus, to fill the empty statues in Saluto, we will make the change to the statue registration from the previous way to register the first users for each statue to a new way that the users are registered in the order of defeats.

3) Improvements to Bottomless Abyss Monsters

We have received much feedback that Bottomless Abyss monsters are a great barrier when you encounter them without sufficient growth.
We will lower the number and HP of Bottomless Abyss monsters in the next season to lower the barrier for new Rune Hunters.

5. Convenience Improvements

The development team agrees that the game’s convenience needs to be improved..
To answer the requests from many of you, We will add a feature to save selected information of Chaos Stone in the next season.
Other than that, we will add a function to display all descriptions of Zodiac Nodes, and a ‘Withdraw All’ feature in Compendium.
We will continue to make more improvements to other elements that we were unable to address 
this time.

While we have been giving extensive consideration to the game content internally, the way we have communicated with you may have not been the most effective.
Moving forward, we will try to share more details on the future of the development through various ways.

About the Next Season

We hope we’ve answered some of your questions about the direction of development. Below, we’ll share details about the next season.

1. Scenario Addition
The player and Canna arrive in Nemera’s city Ghieva, looking for the Zodiac Master.
To meet the mayor ‘Hatus,’ known as the Zodiac Master, you two enter the Arena together.
At the Arena, a boy trying to steal a participation ticket and a mysterious man named ‘Oppert’ appear and the truth behind the stories starts to reveal.
Please check the story of Arena out yourself in the game that opens the first half of the Act 14.

2. Season Content: Arena
You can enter the Arena by collecting Essence dropped in the Chaos Dungeon.
You can obtain growth gear by defeating the bosses that appear consecutively in the Arena.
The obtained gear can be added to the extended Gear Slot, and will summon the soul of the boss monster (provisional name) by chance to support your attacks.

3. Zodiac Specialization Node Renewal
Zodiac Specialization Nodes will be drastically improved in the next season.
We are currently working on original nodes for Special Nodes to provide the Rune Hunters with a different kind of fun that was not experienced before.
To mention one of them, Bowguns that have been ignored so far will receive Specialization Nodes.
We look forward to your creative builds combining new nodes.

4. Tier 10 Charm and the New Charm Essence
Charm will be extended to Tier 10 from 9.
In addition, a new Essence to regrant the Options to a desired Charm will be released, and this will partially help lower the difficulty of setting Charms.


To conclude,

we understand that Rune Hunters want a changed game, not the game getting ready to be changed,
and we are committed to working hard so that you can feel the changes in the future.

We will continue to put our best effort into running the remaining Season Re:Birth and preparing for the next season.
We look forward to your support and anticipation.

Thank you.

notes.title: Nov. 14 Server Patch
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER will be undergoing a server patch on Nov. 14 (Thu) to address identified issues.

Please refer to the following information for details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]Nov. 14 Server Patch[/b]

[b]1. Server Patch Schedule:[/b] Nov. 14 (Thu) 11:00 (UTC+9)
* The server patch will proceed without maintenance.
* The game will therefore be available to play while the server patch is underway.

[b]2. Server Patch Details[/b]
- The issue where the debuff effect from obtaining Energy does not remain when using 'Extract Energy' will be fixed.
- The issue where 'Eunos Dungeon Sub Quest' proceeds abnormally in certain situations will be fixed.
- The issue where the number of projectile decreases when awakening 'Unleash Lightning Shot [Origin]' will be fixed.
- The issue where the stats of each Energy's debuff in the tooltips of Energy-related Skill/Link Runes are displayed different from the actually applied stats will be fixed.
※ The adjusted debuff stats were applied in the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, but the tooltips are displaying the previous stats which will be fixed during the patch.
ㄴ Earth Energy: (Before) Decreases Spell DMG by 10% > (After) Decreases Spell DMG by 20%
ㄴ Fire Energy: (Before) Decreases Attack DMG by 10% > (After) decreases Attack DMG by 20%
ㄴ Cold Energy: (Before) Decreases Critical Chance by 2% > (After) Decreases Critical Chance by 4%
ㄴ Lightning Energy: (Before) Decreases Maximization Chance by 1% > (After) Decreases Maximization Chance by 2%
ㄴ Poison Energy: (Before) Increases Resource Cost by 3% > (After) Increases Resource Cost by 6%

[b]3. To Note[/b]
- Please exit the game completely before logging in again for the patch to be applied.
- Please note that you will not be able to enter the [b][u]Auction House[/u][/b], [b][u]Constellation of Time[/u][/b], [b][u]Chaos Dungeons[/u][/b], and [b][u]Eunos Dungeons[/u][/b] for 10 minutes before and after the patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Please be advised that players may experience temporary disconnections while the patch is underway.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Rune Hunter Growth Pass
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
　
UNDECEMBER's Season Re:Birth is finally here!
Along with the new season, the Rune Hunter Growth Pass has also been released!
　
Play the game with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass to get various rewards as you grow!
You can view the Rune Hunter Growth Pass by pressing the [Event] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
　
Please see below for more details on the Rune Hunter Growth Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ Rune Hunter Growth Pass
The Rune Hunter Growth Pass, a product that gives you rewards every time your character levels up, will be released.
　
■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Period
- After the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the next Season update
　
■ What is the Rune Hunter Growth Pass?
- Level up your character to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.
- Rune Hunter Growth Pass rewards start from Lv. 5 and go up to Lv. 100, increasing by increments of 5 levels.
- You can purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Playing in Season Normal Mode will not affect your Pass in Season Hardcore Mode.
　
■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Obtain by reaching the required character levels.
- Premium Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Premium Pass and reaching the required character levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6e5536b17c38c0dc89ccbecf33a9843fa4c7a612.png[/img]

■ Premium Reward Details
- When you purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Premium Pass and reach the required Pass levels, you can obtain Premium Rewards as well as Normal Rewards.
- With Premium Rewards, you can claim Rewards that are of higher value.
- Purchased Premium Passes will only be active during the current Pass period, so please ensure that you claim your rewards before the Pass period ends.
　
■ To Note
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.
※ You can only obtain Premium Rewards if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience more exciting journeys with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass!
　
Thank you.

notes.title: New/Returning User Attendance Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters. 

In celebration of UNDECEMBER's Season Re:Birth, we have prepared the New/Returning User Attendance Event.

Participate in the attendance event that will greatly assist you in a new beginning!
You can view the New/Returning User Attendance Event by pressing the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.

Please see below for more details on the New/Returning User Attendance Event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ New/Returning User Attendance Event
The New/Returning User Attendance event, which offers rewards every day for 28 days, will be added for new and returning Rune Hunters.
  
■ New/Returning User Attendance Event Period
- After the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the next Season update
  
■ What is the New/Returning User Attendance Event? 
- The New/Returning User Attendance event grants rewards for a total of 28 days and will be available for only one season.
- The New/Returning User Attendance event can run simultaneously with the regular attendance event.
- The New/Returning User Attendance will be integrated across accounts without distinguishing between Standard and Season.
  
■ How to Participate 
- You can participate via the screen that appears by clicking the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
- You can obtain the activated rewards by clicking the [Receive Reward] button.
  
■ New/Returning User Attendance Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dcd91ae36f44368c095e0dbec94472ab88454533.png[/img]

■ To Note  
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ The attendance information is refreshed every day at 9:00 (UTC+9). 
※ You must obtain your rewards directly yourself, and obtained rewards will be sent to your bag.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the period ends.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ Rune Hunters who create their accounts and log in for the first time during the event period will be considered new users.
※ If your last login date is more than 30 days prior to the start date of the corresponding attendance event, you will be considered a returning user.
※ The New/Returning status will be maintained until the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance event ends.
※ The New/Returning status will only apply to the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Participate in the attendance event to support your new beginning! 　
  
Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Zodiac Walker Renewal (Edited on Nov. 1 11:35 (UTC+9))
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) New Season Update, sales for the current Zodiac Walker will end, and will be renewed.
Therefore, we would like to present you with a preview of the new Zodiac Walker in the Season Re:Birth.
  
Please see below for more details.
  
※ The information may change when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◆ Advance Notice on Zodiac Walker Renewal
  
■ Renewal Schedule 
- After the Nov. 7 (Thu) 2024 Season Re:Birth Update
  
■ End of Sales for Zodiac Walker
- Following the scheduled maintenance on Nov. 7 (Thu), sales for the existing Zodiac Walker (7 Days/28 Days) will end for renewal.
- As for the Zodiac Walker you purchased at the Paid Shop, which is in effect, we will sort out the affected Rune Hunters and refund Diamonds.
※ Zodiac Walker included in Packages as a free product (bonus) or given through an Event will be excluded from the refund.
※ All the benefits given by an activated Zodiac Walker (Zodiac Walker Gift Selection Chest and free Rubies) will be excluded from the refund.
  
■ New Products: Zodiac Runner / Zodiac Sprinter
- After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, Zodiac Runner and Zodiac Sprinter will be newly sold at the Paid Shop.
- New products have more improved benefits compared to the existing Zodiac Walker, and the Zodiac Sprinter has additional special features, including ‘Auto Disassemble’ and ‘Expand Bag’.
※ Please see the in-game Paid Shop and UNDECEMBER New Product and Package Sales notice for further details about the new products, including the product price.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/35784e91813348d091598bde1dbe3d7fc0f1ccdc.png[/img]
※ You can obtain Resurrection Scroll, Identification Scrolls, and Major Light Elements from the Zodiac Runner Gift Box.
※ You can obtain Darkness Energies, Unstable Rune Hunter Elixir, and Fountains of Clear Wisdom from the Zodiac Sprinter Gift Box.

■ Zodiac Runner / Sprinter Gift Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/273cf4bcdc4fc5e961423c143cf83a1685a9195e.png[/img]

■ Zodiac Sprinter Upgrade
- Although you cannot purchase a Zodiac Sprinter when a Zodiac Runner is activated, a function to upgrade the Zodiac Runner to a Zodiac Sprinter is provided.
- When upgrading, you can spend additional cost in proportion to the remaining time of the Zodiac Runner to activate the benefits of a Zodiac Sprinter.
  
■ To Note  
※ The information may change when the update takes place.
※ Zodiac Walker included in Packages as a free product or given through an Event will be excluded from the refund.
※ Zodiac Walker included in Packages as a free product or given through an Event remaining in Storage or Bag will be deleted after the Nov. 7 (Thu) maintenance.
※ All the benefits given by an activated Zodiac Walker (Zodiac Walker Gift Selection Chest and free Rubies) will be excluded from the refund.
※ Refunded Diamonds will be immediately given to your account and be added to the Diamonds you own.
※ Refunded Diamonds will be free currency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
Please look forward to the new products of Season Re:Birth.
  
Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Nov. 7 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
 
There will be various changes coming into effect with the new season update that is taking place on Nov. 7 (Thu).
 
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 5, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season Re:Birth update.
 
※ The information may change when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Auction House Measures

◆ Auction House Suspension Measures
After Nov. 4 (Mon) 2024, 11:00 (UTC+9), you will no longer be able to register new items at the Trading Post and Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

◈ Content Reset

◆ Chaos Statue Reset and Current Chaos Cards
Your Chaos Statue and Chaos Card will not be reset during the Nov. 7 (Thu) Season Re:Birth update and will remain as they are.
※ Chaos Statue Level will be recorded on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.

◆ Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring Reset (Added on Nov. 1 12:05 (UTC+9))
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring of the Chaos Statue will be reset.

If you have any unclaimed rewards saved in the Chaos Ring, please claim them before the maintenance.

◆ Black Market Reset
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
 
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please use all the Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests you own before the update takes place. 
 
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season Re:Birth maintenance.

◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
 
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
 
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

◆ Constellation of Time Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.

◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

◆ Mastery Reset 
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
  
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

◆ Rune Master Points Reset
After the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.

◈ Balance and Content Adjustments

◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, certain Runes' effects will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/726e67ba8c640d4c61905d3bf9e8c57b462eab6b.png[/img]

◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9f1897e0d64d5849fc7564b84daa48e7c6260bfd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b002171aa0e0a91f186f0d96ea164a66c0bcc1ea.png[/img]

◆ Adjustments to Skill Rune Awakening
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, the balance of some Skill Runes' Awakenings will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9b1c7e7f6cee4fcc2da7cefbc93b7ab237df5d1a.png[/img]

◆ Improvement to Energy Effects
With the Nov. 7 (Thu) update, Energy Effects will be improved.

notes.title: Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters. 

A new Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance filled with various rewards will begin, along with the new UNDECEMBER!

Let the Attendance help you with your fresh new start, Rune Hunters!
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/2f41bf3a24d6ba81648e00d370a583756ed182fa.png[/img]

[b]◆ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance[/b]
A new Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance will be starting.
   
[b]■ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance Period[/b]
- After Oct. 1 (Tue) 09:00 - Until Nov. 1 (Fri) 08:59 (UTC+9)
   
[b]■ What is Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance?[/b]
- Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance allows you to earn rewards for 28 days by attending.
- You can obtain even more rewards by purchasing Royal Tickets.
- Royal Tickets can be purchased up to one day before the Royal Monthly Attendance ends.
- When you purchase a Royal Ticket, you can attend up to a day before the last attendance date by using Rubies.
- If you purchase a Royal Ticket partway through, you can receive the Royal Bonus rewards for the days you attended previously.
- Attendance will be integrated across accounts without distinguishing between Standard and Season.
- Any Attendance rewards not claimed by the end of the Attendance will be deleted.
   
[b]■ How to Participate in the Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance[/b]
- You can participate via the screen that appears by clicking the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
- You can obtain the activated rewards by clicking the [Receive Reward] button.
   
[b]■ Normal/Royal Monthly Attendance Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8cf30860e22ef6c781b516b32892f7bce55107db.png[/img]

[b]■ Royal Attendance Rewards for Royal Tickets [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ade2a9e5e239fdb8230aefc94bfd6a634f231a24.png[/img]

[b]■ To Note   [/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ The attendance information is refreshed every day at 9:00 (UTC+9). 
※ You must obtain your rewards directly yourself, and obtained rewards will be sent to your bag.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the period ends.
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Enjoy UNDECEMBER even more with the new attendance!
   
Thank you.

- Rune Hunter Elixirs consumed before the issue was resolved have been reimbursed to the affected Rune Hunters.

[b]2) Compensation Distribution Time: [/b]Sept. 5 (Thu) 14:00 (UTC+9)
Can be obtained through your mailbox from Aug. 30 (Fri) 00:00 until Sep. 5 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC+9)
※ The compensation will only be sent once per account, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
┗ You can only obtain the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We once again apologize for any inconvenience caused by this issue, and we promise to continue working to provide a more comfortable gaming experience for our Rune Hunters.

Thank you.

notes.title: New/Returning User Attendance Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  　
In Season 5 of Undecember, a new event called the New/Returning User Attendance Event has been added.  　
  　
Participate in the attendance event that will greatly assist you in a new beginning! 　
You can view the New/Returning User Attendance Event by pressing the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
  　
Please see below for more details on the New/Returning User Attendance Event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ New/Returning User Attendance Event[/b]
The New/Returning User Attendance event, which offers rewards every day for 28 days, will be added for new and returning Rune Hunters.
  　
[b]■ New/Returning User Attendance Event Period  　[/b]
- After the Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Season 6 update 　
  　
[b]■ What is the New/Returning User Attendance Event?  　[/b]
- The New/Returning User Attendance event grants rewards for a total of 28 days and will be available for only one season.
- The New/Returning User Attendance event can run simultaneously with the regular attendance event.
- Attendance will be integrated across accounts without distinguishing between Standard and Season.
  　
[b]■ How to Participate  [/b]　
-You can participate via the screen that appears by clicking the [Attendance] button on the upper-right part of the screen.
- You can obtain the activated rewards by clicking the [Receive Reward] button.

[b]■ New/Returning User Attendance Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8847bb57b687ddfc63103cb1e5ab55bec6d1c197.png[/img]

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change. 　
※ The attendance information will be updated every day at 09:00 (UTC+9). 　
※ You must obtain your rewards directly yourself, and obtained rewards will be sent to your bag.
※ Please ensure that you obtain any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends. 　
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through [🔍View Info] in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ Rune Hunters who create their accounts and log in for the first time during the event period will be considered new users.
※ If your last login date is more than 30 days prior to the start date of the corresponding attendance event, you will be considered a returning user.
※ The New/Returning status will be maintained until the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance event ends.
※ The New/Returning status will only apply to the corresponding (New/Returning) attendance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Participate in the attendance event to support your new beginning!  　

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jul. 18 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  
There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jul. 18 (Thu).
  
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 4, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 5 update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Jul. 15 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Content Reset [/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
  
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
  
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Jul. 18 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Keys.
   
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests, Traces of Memory Selection Chests, Legendary Chaos Card Random Chests (Tier 10), and Rare Tier 10 Chaos Card Chests will not be converted into event items, but Chaos Cards obtained by using Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests will be converted into event items.

[b]◆ Removal of Chaos Stones[/b]
※ Chaos Stones will be removed and replaced with Chaos Points starting from Season 5, which can trigger confirmed events.
※ Chaos Points will reset at the beginning of each season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dcf7cc45d38ff70bbb8945e8cb0ea5c481c48cc5.png[/img]
※ Changes are subject to further updates.

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
  
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
  
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 5 maintenance.

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
  
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
  
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
  
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[b]◆ Mastery Reset [/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
  
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[b]◆ Rune Master Points Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Balance and Content Adjustments [/b]

[b]◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the effects for certain Runes will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d9980b39a588ed1bd0770492425fe42a4bc48e2f.png[/img]

[b]◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8df975061fd6ee56244349faeb7104b9a822facb.png[/img]

[b]◆ Adjustments to Awakened Skill Runes[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the balance for the Awakening of certain Skill Runes will be adjusted.
After the update, affected Awakened Runes will revert to their normal state, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stones' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/70df3f7e49e5a09b2b24f594026fd177d12a9cea.png[/img]

[b]◆ Changes to Energy Effects[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Energy Effects will be changed.

[b]◆ Improvements to Zodiac Nodes[/b]
- The effect of 'Installation Expert' among the Zodiac Greed Specialization nodes will be improved.
- The effect of 'Go-Getter' among the  Zodiac Greed Specialization nodes will be improved.
- Certain options and the balance of Normal Zodiac nodes will be adjusted.

[b]◆ Improvements to Gear Options[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, options for certain gear will be improved.

[b]◆  Improvements to the Disassemble Feature[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the Disassemble feature will be improved.
Due to these changes, disassembling the same item before and after the update may result in different Disassemble Results.

[b]◆ Removal of Chaos Stones Following Improvements to Chaos Statue[/b]
During the Season 5 update, the Chaos Statue will be improved, and as a result, the item 'Chaos Stone' will be removed.
Any 'Chaos Stones' that you own will be converted into 'Chaos Points' along with the Season 5 update.

[b]◆ Changes Following Improvements to Enchant Gear and Simplification of Essences[/b]
With the improvements to Gear Enchant and Essences in the Season 5 update, certain Essences will be removed.
All Essences that will be removed will be retrieved, and replacement items will be sent via Mail based on the criteria below.

[b]■ Unavailable and Removed Items[/b]
※ The contents of Chest items containing Essences scheduled for removal will be adjusted.
※ Bundle items registered in the Auction House will be forcibly changed to the designated reward items.
※ Please note that the 2 Essences related to Legendary Unique items will be removed in a later season.
※ All of the Essence Pieces will be removed during the Season 5 update. Please make sure to use all of your Essence Pieces before the update.

[b]◆ Changes to Essences[/b]
Vesper Essence will be improved to be usable on Legendary items as well.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Guaranteed/Reversion Transfer[/b]
Alchemy Guaranteed/Reversion Transfer will be removed during the Season 5 update.
The names and uses of related materials will be changed.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Rune Synthesis Mileage[/b]
※ Due to the removal of the Rune Synthesis feature in Alchemy, any Synthesis Mileage you currently have will be reset.
※ If you have met the mileage requirements but have not claimed their rewards, we will send the rewards via mail.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Formula Page[/b]
After the Season 5 update, the Alchemy Formula category and Formula page items will be removed.
Changes will be made so that some elixirs that could be crafted through the Formula page can be crafted without the corresponding items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Information on the End of Season 4 [/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 4[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8cd94f14200c8e6888b801e4e3d88df09b5d326a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 4[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 5.
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

※ The information may change when the update takes place.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 5.
  
Thank you.

notes.title: Puru the Clock Rabbit's Login Event Rewards Distribution Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would first like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to your gameplay.

We are currently looking into the issue where Puru the Clock Rabbit's Login Event rewards are not given to certain Rune Hunters through the mail.

Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]Puru the Clock Rabbit's Login Event Rewards Distribution Issue[/b]

[b]1. Affected Mail:[/b] Mail related to the ongoing Puru the Clock Rabbit's Login Event held from Jun. 10 (Mon)
※ We will update this notice when the issue is fixed.

[b]2. Affected Users:[/b] Users who logged into the game during the event period but could not obtain the rewards
※ We are carrying out further investigations into accounts that are experiencing this issue and are preparing to send out compensation once the investigations are complete.

[b]3. Compensation: [/b]Puru the Clock Rabbit's Pocket Watch x200
※ You can obtain the compensation through your mailbox until Jun. 19 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+9).
※ The compensation will only be sent once per account for both modes, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
┗ You can only obtain the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode.

[b]4. Added Information: [/b]Additional event items will be given between Jun. 15 (Sat) and Jun. 19 (Wed). (Added on Jun. 14 18:12 (UTC+9))
- Compensation: Puru the Clock Rabbit's Pocket Watch x100 (Before) → x200 (After)
※ You can obtain the compensation through your mailbox by logging into the game every day (00:00-23:59 (UTC+9)) during the event period.
※ The compensation will only be sent once per account for both modes, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
┗ You can only obtain the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode.
※ The attendance reward mail will arrive by 23:59 (UTC+9) on the day the mail is sent.

Rewards that are not obtained within the mail expiry time will expire and disappear.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We would like to apologize for the inconvenience. 
We will make an effort to solve the issue as soon as possible.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER’s Operational Policy will be revised on May. 2 (Thu) 2024

Please see below for more details on the changes in order to avoid any inconvenience to your gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes[/b]

✔ Affected Policy: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy
✔ Effective Date: May. 2 (Thu) 2024
✔ Key Changes 
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers will be added.

✔ Added Information
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers
① If, during the consultation process for resolving inquiries arising from game use, any act that disrupts the duties of a customer service worker occurs and causes physical or mental distress to the customer service worker as described in the second paragraph, measures may be taken to limit consultations and game usage to prevent and protect the customer service worker from health hazards under Article 41 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act.
② Acts that disrupt the duties of a customer service worker include the following:
(1) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that induce fear or anxiety.
(2) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that provoke sexual humiliation or repugnance.
(3) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that cause personal insult.
(4) Making an inquiry that contains expressions such as profanity and such that may directly or indirectly cause mental harm.
(5) Making an inquiry that contains jokes or expressions unrelated to the consultation that may cause discomfort.
③ If a customer service worker is disrupted from performing their duties, the following restrictions may apply in accordance with the operational policies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d24ccb8710b23a5e5bedf8acd53ad0909bacae13.png[/img]
* Disrupting consultation duties may result in the termination of the consultation and game restrictions according to the policies in place.
* If operations are disrupted multiple times after the third offense, the 7-day game restriction may be accumulated.
* If consultation duties are disrupted by multiple accounts from the same device or network connection, it may be considered as being caused by the same user, and game restrictions may be imposed accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Please check the Operational Policy page at the effective date to see the revised Operational Policy.

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Rune Hunter Growth Pass
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.  

UNDECEMBER's Season 4 is finally here!
Along with the new season, the Rune Hunter Growth Pass has also been released!

Play the game with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass to get various rewards as you grow!
You can view the Rune Hunter Growth Pass by pressing the [Event] button on the upper-right part of the screen.

Please see below for more details on the Rune Hunter Growth Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Rune Hunter Growth Pass
The Rune Hunter Growth Pass, which is a product where you can claim rewards every time your character levels up, has been released.[/b]

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Period[/b]
- After the Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Season 5 update

[b]■ What is the Rune Hunter Growth Pass?
- Level up your character to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.[/b]
- Rune Hunter Growth Pass rewards start from Lv. 5 and go up to Lv. 100, increasing by increments of 5 levels.
- You can purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Passes purchased in Season Origin Mode will not affect your gameplay in Season Normal Mode.

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Obtain by reaching the required character levels.
- Premium Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Premium Pass and reaching the required character levels.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/46c1cb0003ecc4a81a048a66a004439b87d75331.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Reward Details[/b]
- When you purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Premium Pass and reach the required Pass levels, you can obtain 'Premium Rewards' as well as Normal Rewards.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain rewards that are of higher value.
- Purchased Premium Passes will only be active during the current Pass period, so please ensure that you claim your rewards before the Pass period ends.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ Please ensure that you claim any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.
※ You can only claim Premium Rewards if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience more exciting journeys with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass!

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Mar. 28 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Mar. 28 (Thu).
 
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 3, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 4 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Mar. 25 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
 
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
 
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Mar. 28 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Chaos Keys.
 
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests and Traces of Memory Selection Chests will not be converted to event items, 
    but Chaos Cards obtained through those items will be converted to event items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
 
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
 
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 4 maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
 
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
 
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
 
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Skill Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Skill Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6e6c3dd01789b4c781cdadfd647c67a21f2b9cfd.png[/img]

[b]◆ Link Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Link Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6b107c1b713d262aab20489a584819952587bef3.png[/img]

[b]◆ Gear Option Improvements[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, options for certain gear will be improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b2a498f2327a47422869ce9efa912aa374ee41b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Information on End of Season 2[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 3[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/22cbf9eda8eff5c01b63bbe92d175c9086b47710.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 3[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Certain Paid Shop Product Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters. 
 
A new system will be implemented in [b]'Collector's Treasure House'[/b] and [b]'Croco's Support Chest'[/b] through the new season update after Season 3 ends.
 
We would like to notify you in advance about what will happen so you can know about the changes that will take place in advance.
 
Please see below for more details.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d1097cc5a96caa93bad66cf55d5c7bd55f9b3b81.png[/img]

[b]◈ Advance Notice on Certain Paid Shop Product Changes[/b]

[b]◆ New Guaranteed Reward Points [/b]
- Guaranteed Reward Points will be implemented in [b]'Collector's Treasure House'[/b] and [b]'Croco's Support Chest'[/b] and rewards will be given per stage according to the current level.
- Designated items are guaranteed to be given when the last stage is achieved.
※ Guaranteed Reward Points will only be applied to [b]'Collector's Treasure House'[/b] and [b]'Croco's Support Chest'[/b].
※ Accumulated points will remain even if a Legendary item is obtained while collecting points.
※ Guaranteed Reward Points are shared between characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Improvements to Support Chest Names and Border Colors[/b]
- The names of chests such as [b]'Legendary Treasure Chest'[/b] and [b]'Unique Support Chest'[/b] in [b]'Collector's Treasure House'[/b] and [b]'Croco's Support Chest'[/b] will be changed and the colors of effects in the Check Rewards screen will be changed. 
※ Details related to the changes in colors will be revealed in the future.
 
[b]■ Examples of New Chest Names[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/28dcb3faeab11bd0126a3df0058d8f22d3c11bc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d1097cc5a96caa93bad66cf55d5c7bd55f9b3b81.png[/img]

[b]※ The details are still in the planning stage and may change during development.[/b]
 
We hope the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
Please support and look forward to the Season 4 update that will be released in the future.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: Jan. 17 Notice Regarding the 'Absorb Energy' Skill Rune
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would like to provide information about the 'Absorb Energy' skill that has become an issue in the UNDECEMBER community.

First of all, we would like to apologize for not providing clear information regarding the 'Absorb Energy' skill and causing confusion.

Rune Hunters reported a total of 2 issues regarding this matter.
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Issue where energy can be obtained while the effects of the 'Absorb Energy' skill are active[/b]
- Energy should not be obtainable while the effects of the 'Absorb Energy' skill are active.
 This issue will be resolved through the [b]Jan. 18 (Thu) 2024 maintenance.[/b]

[b]■ The Amplification effect of the 'Absorb Energy' skill[/b]
- The following areas synergize with the 'Absorb Energy' skill's Amplification effect.

[b]1) [/b]The 'Adds 50% of Main Element Increase/Amplification of Activation Skill to Element of Target Skill when the Main Elements of Activation and Target Skills are different' option of Link Runes such as Spell Activation on Attack Hit, Spell Activation upon Enemy Kill, Spell Activation on Spell Hit, Spell Activation while Channeling, and Spell Activation on Hit

[b]2) [/b]The 'Increase Max Energy' option of Unique items

The stats were calculated correctly based on the information above.
We are aware that this issue was highlighted in areas where DPS performance can be extremely heightened such as the Training Arena, and would like to inform you that this is not a bug because it is within the structurally acceptable range.

※ However, we are monitoring balance-related aspects, such as the difficulty of reaching the maximum energy limit and maintaining the Amplification effect, and could improve these parts in later seasons if the mechanics are regarded to not be balanced enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We would like to once again apologize for the trouble our Rune Hunters experienced due to the delay in sharing this notice.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

notes.title: Coco's Great Adventure
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.    
    
Considerable time has passed since our Rune Hunters embarked on their adventure. 
We would like to sincerely thank you for loving UNDECEMBER so far.  
    
We prepared a new event called 'Coco's Great Adventure' to return the love you have shown us so far.  
    
Please see below for more details.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c6c0c07eb00b1f03220d2bfbb9c93cb721833b3b.png[/img]

[b]◆ Coco's Great Adventure Event[/b]   
    
[b]■ Event Period    [/b]
- After the Jan. 11 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Feb. 15 (Thu) 2024 maintenance 
    
[b]■ Event Details    [/b]
- Capture tiles by moving Coco and obtain rewards by battling enemies.  
- You can move to the next stage if you meet the clear requirements of a stage.  
- Rewards can be obtained according to the number of tiles captured and the stages cleared. 
- You cannot move to previous stages after clearing a stage.  
    
[b]■ How to Participate   [/b] 
- Press the [Event] button on the top-right part of the screen in the game.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/435b1a461835f1b1931ff495e799ee3b3817398e.png[/img]
- If you click a tile in the direction you want to move, Coco will go and capture the tile. You will obtain the rewards of the tile.
- 'Coco's Snacks' are required to make Coco move.   
- Combat will begin if you move on to an enemy tile.   
- Combat takes place by rolling dice, and you will win if the spots on the dice meet the victory requirements. 
- You will fail if you don't meet the victory requirements. You can either choose between the 'Give up' or 'Reroll' button. 
If you press the 'Give up' button, you will move to the previous tile after giving up capturing the tile. The Coco's Snacks you spent will not be refunded.
- After you fail, you can use 'Reroll Tickets' to roll the dice again.  
You can also purchase 'Reroll Tickets' after failing.   
- If you use 'Add Dice Tickets', the number of dice you roll in one attempt will increase. 
The number of dice added will remain until you press the 'Give up' button while fighting one enemy. 

※ An issue where the shortest route was not taken when moving to certain tiles has occurred and will be fixed in the future.
Coco's Snacks will not be consumed for detours.   

[b]Event Exclusive Currency Information[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0a9b72da989ca98220bdfbee9ee4c2a6b51e63de.png[/img]

[b]Coco's Snack Information[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6a92ccc48eade7703cde5ae1ee1aed5cb60eab54.png[/img]
※ This item can be obtained by chance through all monsters on the field.  
※ The special days designated during the event period are as below.  
Special Days: Jan. 13 / Jan. 14 / Jan. 20 / Jan. 21 / Jan. 27 / Jan. 28 / Feb. 03 / Feb. 04 / Feb. 09 / Feb. 10 / Feb. 11 / Feb. 12

[b]Dice Chance Information[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/56a9ce6726f0c32b73aaf0b8d0849d6b2b3dbb47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b2efb3601069a4c2c8165b3066f7abff26a533f5.png[/img]
[b]Item Details  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9caf4e8afe1984f54a2bf1113d76e9ba76ce568b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/59e01e4f0d12ede53f32f931662937c57c6c0b90.png[/img]
[b]Item Details  [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/219c163d1572c402c785bcc5e728e2dca329e848.png[/img]

[b]■ Event Rewards[/b]
    
[b]Tile Capture Rewards[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/72574bba6fa6404c593a0c5c080769334f2ddca6.png[/img]

[b]Stage Details[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b9a32a285286a18aa740a416f88a9bc77c0a3b0d.png[/img]

[b]■ Coco's Suitcase Contents   [/b]
- You can get 1 of the following items according to chance if you use a Coco's Suitcase.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c3c7351253390fce98beeb7829de95c02c871c36.png[/img]

[b]■ Items That Will Be Deleted After the Event Ends  [/b]
- Coco's Snack    
- Snack Coco Dropped    
- Coco's Suitcase    
    
[b]■ To Note  [/b]  
※ Event details may be subject to change.
※ Event items that are not used will disappear after the Feb. 15 (Thu) 2024 maintenance. 
※ Event items can be sold at Shops, so please ensure that you do not sell them by accident.
※ Event items may be rewarded through other events.
※ A notification will be displayed if there aren't enough snacks or if a tile that can't be moved to is selected, and Coco will not move.
※ For more information on chances for chance-type items, please check the [url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1663916645071015490]▶Notice[/url] of our official website.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope you will continue to spend many more years with UNDECEMBER with this exciting event. 
    
Thank you.

notes.title: Compensation for Hack Detection System Error
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the issue that occurred after the Dec. 7 (Thu) Season 3 update, 
[b]where login restrictions were imposed due to a hack detection system error.[/b]
