notes.title: UNDECEMBER Rune Hunter Growth Pass
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER's Season 3 is finally here!
Along with Season 3, the Rune Hunter Growth Pass has also been released!

Play the game with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass to get various rewards as you grow!
You can view the Rune Hunter Growth Pass by pressing the [Event] button on the upper-right part of the screen.

Please see below for more details on the Rune Hunter Growth Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Rune Hunter Growth Pass
The Rune Hunter Growth Pass, which is a product where you can claim rewards every time your character levels up, has been released.[/b]

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Period[/b]
- After the Dec. 7 (Thu) maintenance - Until before the Season 4 update

[b]■ What is the Rune Hunter Growth Pass?
- Level up your character to certain levels to obtain various rewards that correspond to each level.[/b]
- Rune Hunter Growth Pass rewards start from Lv. 5 and go up to Lv. 100, increasing by increments of 5 levels.
- You can purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Pass once per mode, and your Pass progress will only apply to the mode in which the Pass has been purchased.
 └ E.g. Passes purchased in Season Origin Mode will not affect your gameplay in Season Normal Mode.

[b]■ Rune Hunter Growth Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Obtain by reaching the required character levels.
- Premium Rewards: Obtain by purchasing the Premium Pass and reaching the required character levels.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/80f7a10b88767ed79201c0e69e667bcd93475d3d.png[/img]

[b]■ Premium Reward Details[/b]
- When you purchase the Rune Hunter Growth Premium Pass and reach the required Pass levels, you can obtain [b]Premium Rewards[/b] as well as Normal Rewards.
- With Premium Rewards, you can claim rewards that are of higher value, such as [b]20 Rune Candor Essences.[/b]
- Purchased Premium Passes are only active during the current Pass period, so please ensure that you claim your rewards before the Pass period ends.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The period and details outlined above may be subject to change.
※ Please ensure that you claim any activated level rewards before the Pass period ends.
※ You can only claim Premium Rewards if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in the same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Experience more exciting journeys with the Rune Hunter Growth Pass!

Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

A new season of the Zodiac Pass,
where you can get various rewards and benefits through your journey with the new UNDECEMBER, has begun!

A few small changes will be made to the Zodiac Pass for Season 3!
Please see below for more details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c428697b0f0c62b9c277439fdecc1caf219c6616.png[/img]

[b]◆ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1[/b]
  A new Zodiac Pass is beginning!

[b]※ Season 3 Zodiac Pass 1 Changes [/b]
 - The Zodiac Pass period will change from [b]2 weeks ▶ 1 month. [/b]
 - The Zodiac Pass max level will change from [b]Level 20 ▶ Level 25.[/b]
 - The EXP you obtain from Zodiac Pass missions will change.

[b]■ Zodiac Pass 1 Period[/b]
 - After the Dec. 7 (Thu) maintenance – Before the 2024 Jan. 4 (Thu) maintenance (UTC+9)

[b]■ What is the Zodiac Pass?[/b]
 - By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
 - Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- You can purchase the Zodiac Pass with your account from Standard or Season Mode.
- If you purchase the Zodiac Pass in Season Mode, its missions, rewards, and levels will be shared across all the difficulty modes within Season Mode.
└ E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/635224d44737f091d8dee80a83bfe84e6a1300e0.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Missions[/b]
 - You can check missions through the ‘Event’ icon in the game.
 - There are both Daily Missions and Season Missions.
 - Season Missions can only be cleared once during the Zodiac Pass period, and more Pass EXP can be obtained through them.
 - During the Zodiac Pass period, 5 Daily Missions will be given every day, and you can obtain Pass EXP by clearing them.
 - Daily Missions will be refreshed every day at 09:00 (UTC+9).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/9af5c1a95f6bb6d435d632218471811cd42f0d8c.png[/img]
[b]■ Zodiac Pass Rewards[/b]
 - Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
 - Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/bf2affd11d312c8f920f2b1310af7a848bfc5456.png[/img]
[b]■ Premium Pass Information[/b]
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
 in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
 - If you purchase the Premium Pass, special benefits will be applied during the Pass period.
● Alchemy Slot +1
● Alchemy Acceleration +50%
● Stardust of Oblivion (Zodiac free reset)
※ Premium Pass benefits are only granted to the mode in which you purchase the Pass (Standard/Season).
 - 1,180 Diamonds are required to activate the Premium Pass.
 - Your purchased Premium Pass and its benefits will only be valid during the Zodiac Pass 1 period.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ The Zodiac Pass period and details may be subject to change.
※ Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are applied separately for Standard and Season Mode (but they are not separated for the difficulty modes within Season Mode).
※ You must purchase the Premium Pass in either Standard or Season Mode to claim Premium Pass Rewards.
※ Premium Pass benefits are only applied to the Standard or Season Mode in which you purchase the pass.
(E.g. If you purchase the Premium Pass in Season Mode, its benefits will only affect Season Characters)
※ You can see the contents of Chest items through ‘🍳View Info’ in the item’s tooltip in the game.
※ To see chance information for chance-based items, please check this Notice on the official website.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your level, activated benefits, and points will be reset and rewards changed.
※ If you have any activated level rewards,
  please claim them before the end of the period (before the mm. dd (Thu) maintenance).
※ For inquiries about the product, please contact FLOOR Support.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Use the Zodiac Pass and add extra fun to your new journey! 

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Dec. 7 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Dec. 7 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 2, 
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 3 update.

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Dec. 4 (Mon). patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.
Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Dec. 7 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update. 
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]

With the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 3 maintenance takes place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 8
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I’m Director Sang Kwon Han.[/b]

I hope you are well despite the changing season and winter chill. I imagine that things have been quiet since the end of UNDECEMBER’s Halloween Event.

As director, my first concern was on how to ensure that Rune Hunters were enjoying UNDECEMBER. That is why we held the Halloween Event, and while doing so, we found that there were still various shortcomings.

However, even though our first steps may be small, we will continue to work hard to ensure that Rune Hunters can fully enjoy the game. In this spirit, we wish to share some details on the upcoming Season 3 update.

[b]■ December Season 3 Update[/b]

The Season 3 update will be taking place soon on Dec. 7 (Thu). We have worked hard to improve some of the shortcomings of Season 2 and to ensure that players can experience the enjoyment that comes from farming.

[b]1. Improvements to Episodes[/b]
While we improved the gameplay routes for Episodes 1 and 2 in order to decrease repetitive play, we were unable to implement the same measures for Episode 3. But with Season 3, we have reduced the gameplay routes for Episode 3 Act 11 and 12 to the minimum, which will allow users to reach end content more quickly. However, as the Hira theme is common to both Season 2 and 3, we believe that it is premature for us to reduce the gameplay routes for Act 13, and will therefore only do so for another season in the future.

Moreover, in consideration of those Rune Hunters who may not place much importance on completing the game’s stories, we have added an ‘Episode Skip’ feature. Once you use the ‘Episode Skip Ticket’, you can skip the Episode sections you want to, and appropriate EXP and base rewards that will allow you to play the next section will be provided.
* The Episode Skip feature can be used by purchasing an ‘Episode Skip Ticket’ from the Shop after the Season 3 update.
* Please note that you will be removed from content rankings if you skip Episodes.

[b]2. New Runes and Improvements[/b]
As mentioned in the Director’s Letter that was published in September, we have worked to improve Physical Element builds. To supplement some inconvenient factors that have existed since the beginning as well as the weaker areas of Physical Element builds, we have added the new Runes below.

[b]2 new Skill Runes will be added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e0deeb3a6c67839402c345e522faa8d895ce2a94.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=UyIr30F51EQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=3Ps6mQDgk8g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]3 new Link Runes will be added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6ea8d74e42f8c74aa6a40fe289d3ec7d5443bb08.png[/img]

Despite the addition of these new Runes, we realize that they are not enough to bring about a complete change to Physical Element builds. We consider this as only the beginning of our efforts to continuously improve the game.

[b]3. New Unique items and Changes to Skill Mechanisms[/b]
The new Unique items that will be added with Season 3 will bring about significant changes to the roles played by currently neglected Unique Gear. The new Unique Gear will either significantly change skill mechanisms or will have critical options that will play a key role in completing your build. In addition, please note that most of the upcoming changes are centered around Physical Skill Runes as we have focused on improving Physical Element builds for the new season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7702e5c72844bb9b683075c09abfa8646cdacd61.png[/img]

New Unique Gear with certain options that are normally categorized as Legacy options will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/507983a68034ec8de41ca4b2617b8bb1c273cf66.png[/img]

In addition to the Transcendent Unique Gear above that will affect skill mechanisms, Unique Gear that will only drop in Hardcore Mode will also be added. These Unique Gear that are only dropped in Hardcore Mode are highly effective, and will help to heighten the fun of farming that is inherent to this mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a7901fccdb889796ca214c6714af2f9d77b689b1.png[/img]

Various other Unique items will be added along with the ones outlined above, and the ones with more powerful options will only be obtainable from the more difficult sections of the game’s end content. However, please note that the options and values of the new Unique items, including the ones outlined above, may change once the update actually takes place.

[b]4. New Legendary Lacrima Gear[/b]
With the addition of Lacrimas in Season 2, we believe that we were able to significantly increase the breadth of character growth. However, we realize that we neglected to fully exhibit the distinct characteristics of the Lacrima gear, and that is why we will be adding Legendary Lacrimas to the game. Legendary Lacrimas will have 3 gear slots, and 1 Unique slot will be guaranteed. The other slots will be set from Magic to Unique grade according to set chances.

Legendary Lacrima Gear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/eb4e66dc7c2c8c9513f281bfff333bfbc7f263fe.png[/img]

Moreover, the parts for the Unique Gear slots that can be attached to Legendary Lacrimas will be set according to set chances. We decided that the requirements for equipping gear to current Unique Lacrimas were too limited, and that we wanted to provide a wider equipping range with the new Legendary Lacrimas. Our aim is to ensure that as we improve current Unique items and add new ones, they can be used in various ways through Legendary Lacrimas.

[b]5. Improvements to Chaos Dungeons[/b]
Even though Chaos Dungeons are a key part of UNDECEMBER’s end content, we realize that they still have many problems. We are considering all angles in order to come up with solutions to these problems, and our current aim is to consistently improve the content over time rather than to come up with an immediate and rushed solution. Contrary to the fact that the difficulty levels of Chaos Dungeons suddenly increase from card Lv. 15 and above, the enjoyment that comes from farming is relatively lacking. To tackle this issue, new farming monsters will sometimes appear in dungeons of card Lv. 16 or above. As much as the new farming monsters will be powerful, they will drop befitting rewards. The rewards that are dropped by chance include the Charm Legendary Reversion Essences that were introduced in Season 2, and the powerful Unique Gear that will be newly added. The chances of the new farming monsters appearing will increase the higher the card level, and the max card growth level will be increased to Lv. 35.

Furthermore, convenience improvements are planned for Chaos Dungeons in January.

[b]6. Improvements to Rankings[/b]
We are still reflecting on the fact that we had to suddenly close the game’s Ranking Reward feature during the Season 2 update due to structural issues found with Rankings. We have therefore implemented improvements so that from Season 3, Rankings will end during the season and rewards can be claimed in time with the end of Rankings. We will also be simplifying the currently complicated Ranking categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/de14f171e394b224317b7ecc902fbc6ca936497e.png[/img]

[b]7. Free Pet Ability[/b]
From Season 3, Pet Abilities will be free. They will also be updated so that they are maintained constantly.

[b]8. New Appearance Feature and Improvements[/b]
Wings will be added to the game as a new Appearance feature. A Wings category will be added to costume slots and you can view the products that are available from the Beauty shop. 5 new Wings will be added with Season 3, and they can be obtained both by completing certain content or by purchasing products.

[b]9. End of Crusade of Glory[/b]
As participation rates for the game’s Crusade of Glory are lower than expected, we have decided to permanently close the content. However, rewards for the progress made in Season 2 will still be available to claim after the start of Season 3, and can be used at the Crusade of Glory Shop.

[b]■ Events[/b]
While running the game until now, we have felt that there has been a lack of events in the game. With a Christmas Event that will be as bountiful as the Halloween Event planned for Season 3, we are planning on consistently opening various events so that Rune Hunters can enjoy abundant experiences with UNDECEMBER.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]
The upcoming Season 3 may still seem imperfect at the moment, but we will continue to work hard to add new content that will satisfy Rune Hunters for Season 4 as well. We thank you for your continued support of UNDECEMBER, and we look forward to seeing you in the next Director’s Letter.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Zodiac Point Decrease after Oct. 12 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

This is a notice for Rune Hunters whose Zodiacs were reset or whose Zodiac Points decreased after the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

The two situations mentioned above occurred while adjusting the Zodiac Points of certain characters to be within normal ranges. Certain characters had abnormally high Zodiac Points due to obtaining the 'Stardust of Evolution' from a bug before the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

'Stardust of Evolution' and 'Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ', which can be used to earn Zodiac Points, are obtainable through Saluto's Chaos Sub Quest. All items can be acquired after completing the four quests below.

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution can be obtained
1) Long-haired Stranger (Talk to Leon)
2) Direction of Worry (Talk to Leon)

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ can be obtained
1) Resurrecting Evil (Defeat Serpens)
2) Shadow Game (Talk to the Long-haired Stranger)

Please keep in mind that Zodiac Specialization Points can be invested to the maximum level after completing all of the Chaos Sub Quests above and using the Stardust of Evolution.

Thank you.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 7
notes.content:
Hello, I’m Sang Kwon Han, the new director of UNDECEMBER since September.

I am sure that many of you are surprised by this sudden change in director.

Since UNDECEMBER first launched, the game has gone through much trial and error and has experienced numerous issues. We would like to sincerely thank those who have continued to play UNDECEMBER, and to sincerely apologize for the times where we have disappointed you. However, with the strong belief that UNDECEMBER has the potential to improve and become a model Korean Hack & Slash game, I have taken on the tremendous responsibility of being UNDECEMBER’s director and am now here writing my first letter to you.

In this Director’s Letter, I will briefly outline the direction in which the game’s future updates will head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Looking Back[/b]

We believe that the new Season Mode and other new modes that were suddenly introduced in the past year were all decisions that were inevitable for a Hack & Slash game like UNDECEMBER. However, understanding that these changes were not to the satisfaction of our users, we cannot help but self-reflect on the decisions that were made. Therefore, we are aiming to further improve the quality of the game so that we can fully offer the fun that comes with the Hack & Slash genre, and to establish ourselves as a game that is centered around users by ensuring that we listen to the opinions of our users closely.

First, we will prioritize stability so that we can provide a gaming environment where users can fully enjoy UNDECEMBER. We will continue to adjust the game’s balance and improve issues that were previously neglected.

Second, we will place the inherent fun that comes from combat and hunting in the Hack & Slash genre at the forefront of our aims. Due to this, please note that the development of existing or planned short-term/long-term UNDECEMBER PvP and Guild content may be delayed or discontinued.

Third, we will minimize the nerfs caused by balance changes to skills and builds. Balance changes that will not cause critical issues will be adjusted in time for the next new season.

Fourth, we will offer satisfactory compensation for issues caused by our own mistakes. Until now, there were many occasions where we were unable to provide suitable compensation to users for various issues, including bugs and convenience-related problems. From now on, we will work harder to ensure that we can compensate users for any inconvenience they experience due to issues caused by our mistakes.

[b]■ Key Improvements Planned for Oct. 12 Update[/b]

For the minor update that will be taking place soon on Oct. 12 (Thu), we are planning on taking the first step to improve the game’s deep-rooted convenience issues that have been brought to light by the game’s Origin Mode.

- Improvements to Inventory

Even though farming is a key aspect of UNDECEMBER, the lack of convenience features that allow users to easily view their items in their inventory has caused much inconvenience. To help resolve this, the inventory’s filter feature will be upgraded and the current, inconvenient Favorite feature for items will be improved so that items can be organized more easily.

- Improvements to Pet Feature

A new storage feature for Pets will be added. This will help improve the inconvenience of having to move back and forth between towns and dungeons.

- Improvements to NPC Shops and Addition of New Products

In line with the Hack & Slash genre, chance-based elements will be added to NPC Shops, which currently lack content that involves random chance. Chance-based elements will be added to the Gear Shops of the NPCs Blacksmith Croco and Blacksmith Apprentice Kiroki, which will mean that users can randomly obtain items of up to Unique and Legendary grade when they purchase gear. Moreover, NPC Brown will have new categories that sell Skill Rune Chests and Link Rune Chests, and users can obtain any Rune at random from these new chests.

We hope that these changes will help the issues that surround how ‘Special Runes’ and some Synthesis Runes, which require a relatively long time to obtain, are provided, and particularly hope to partially solve the issue where products from other Guild Shops cannot be purchased due to ‘Special Runes’. The new chance-based elements and Rune Chests will be available to purchase with ‘Gold’.

Moreover, a new Halloween event will take place with the Oct. 12 (Thu) update. This year’s Halloween event will involve high-quality rewards of epic proportions, and we will share more information about it through a notice at a later date. We hope you look forward to it!

[b]■ Season 3 Update Plan[/b]

I will now outline our plans for the Season 3 update that will take place in December. For Season 3, we will improve the quality of current UNDECEMBER content and will focus on the fun that comes with changing your builds.

Out of the 571 Unique Gear that currently exist, we will focus on rebalancing and consistently improving the ones that are not used so that they are not neglected. As Unique items will play a pivotal role in changing your skill builds in the future, we are planning on ensuring that they will help users create more strategic and diverse skill builds. In line with this, we are planning on introducing a new Unique Lacrima item that will help to resolve the restrictions that exist with the current Unique Lacrimas.

In addition, we are aiming to resolve the lack of convenience and expandability for Physical Element builds compared to other Element builds with the Season 3 update. New Physical Element Spell Skills will be added, and we are preparing to reform various existing Physical Element Skills that are not used often.

Finally, one aspect that we thought long and hard about as we planned improvements for the game’s inventory and Pet feature was the Auto Loot feature. With the addition of new content and growth elements as the game went through various changes, it has now become difficult to play the game fluidly without Pets. We have therefore concluded that the Pet feature is no longer aligned with the broader principle of providing ‘convenience’, and the paid Pet feature will therefore become free from Season 3. We hope that this will help many users enjoy the game even more.

[b]■ In Conclusion…[/b]

Since becoming UNDECEMBER’s new director, I have reflected on the issues that have surrounded the game’s management and development until now, and it is with a heavy heart that it has led my first letter to be less aspiring than desired and full of self-reflection.

To mark the change in director and as a symbol of our determination to improve the game in actuality, rather than just through words, we will be sending out ‘Director’s Special Attendance Rewards’ as gifts. We hope that these rewards will help you enjoy UNDECEMBER to its utmost until the Halloween event takes place next month.

Finally, we wish to restate our promise to invest our best efforts in ensuring that we provide you with better services as we prepare for our future updates, and we sincerely thank you again for your continuous support.

We hope that you continue to enjoy your days with UNDECEMBER, and we look forward to seeing you again with a much fuller and richer Director’s Letter next time.

Thank you.

Sang Kwon Han

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Aug. 31 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the Act 13 Hira update that is taking place on Aug. 31 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 1, as well as the temporary suspension of Auction House trading that will take place in preparation for the Season 2 update.

[b]■ Temporary Suspension of Auction House[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Aug. 24 (Thu) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.

Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.

On Aug. 29 (Tue), all Auction House features will be temporarily suspended.
Please collect items from failed/successful trades before this date.

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the temporary suspension measures over the Auction House will be lifted.
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance, you will be able to use the Auction House as normal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) Hira update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

You will be able to use Saluto and Chaos Dungeons once you have cleared the new Act 13 Hira.
We hope you are excited for the new map and the various events that will be added.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.

Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Act 13 Hira update will be converted into event items during the update.

The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Chard Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update and we will send you the ‘Deeds of Promise’ you used for the deleted items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Changes to Disassemble Rewards due to Addition of Higher Option Tiers for Gear[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, higher tiers will be added to item options.

Due to this change in tier range, the disassemble results from before and after the update may be different even if the same item is disassembled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Deletion of Challenge Mode[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the new Hardcore and Origin Modes will be added and the current Challenge Mode will be deleted.

The Challenge Mode rewards, Stardust of Evolution Ⅰ and Ⅱ, will be available through Saluto Chaos sub quests.

※ There may be changes in Zodiac Specialization values due to the changed method for obtaining Stardust of Evolution. 
If your Zodiac Specialization values decrease, please obtain Stardust of Evolution through Chaos Sub Quests before using them. (Added on Aug. 31 22:20 (UTC+9))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Descent Raid Schedule[/b]

Changes have been made to the Descent Raid schedule before the Season 2 update so that we can ensure the stability of our services.

Please see the Content Schedule page for more details.
[[url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1684840347193025906]Link to Content Schedule Page[/url]]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards to Not be Sent on Sept. 4 (Mon) [/b](Added on Aug. 24 12:30 (UTC+9))
As the way in which we send Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards will change with the Season 2 update,
please note that Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards for matches played between Aug. 28 (Mon) – Sept. 3 (Sun) will not be sent to users on the above date.

We ask for your understanding on this matter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Partial Rune Awakening Reset[/b] (Added on Aug. 25 13:50 (UTC+9))
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, some Awakened Runes will be reset due to balance changes.
If you own any Runes that will be reset, we will send you Engraving Stones and Gold according to the type of Rune you have
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Information on End of Season 1[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items that will Move to Standard Mode at End of Season 1[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/533e3bc7e2f8f59f5cb8d5891159a9e1b9aba1d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Items that will Move to Temporary Storage at End of Season 1[/b]
The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to Temporary Slots.
The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to Temporary Slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 3.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 2.

Thank you.

notes.title: Jun. 22 Update (Jun. 23 16:35 UTC+9 Edited)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will take place on Jun. 22 (Thu).

Please see below for more details.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.
※ Information on bug fixes will be released in a separate notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update[/b]
※ These are the updates, improvements, and changes that will come into place with the update.

■ Auction House
- Users’ management of Auction House items will change from being based on character to being based on account.
Please see below for related changes.
  ㄴ All items registered for sale will be viewable to all characters in your account.
  ㄴ Once an item has been auctioned, users will be able to receive payment with characters that did not register the sold item.
E.g.) The payment for an auctioned item that was registered for sale by Character A can be claimed by Character B (however, users cannot claim payments more than once).
  ㄴ All characters in the same mode will be able to cancel items registered for sale.
  ㄴ All items you bid on will be viewable to all characters in your account.
  ㄴ All characters in your account will be able to re-bid.
  ㄴ All characters in your account will be able to receive items after re-bids and after canceled/failed bids.
- After the update, the waiting time for receiving Rubies after selling an item at the Auction House will only be applied when Paid Rubies are included in the trade.
  ㄴ To prevent abuse, Auction House items purchased with Paid Rubies will not be available to re-register for a set amount of time.
- The search categories and tabs in the Auction House will be made clearer.
  * New Category: Essence
  * Moved and New Tabs: Rune Growth Material (Rune category), Chaos Key (Chaos category), Chaos Star (Charm category), Essence/Essence Piece (Essence category), Engraving Stone (Essence category), Engraving Stone Piece (Essence category)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/206901d68e217d331e92913d3780372828a4f926.png[/img]

■ Paid Shop
- The UI will be improved so that the ‘Chaos Tier Stone (Tier 10)’ product in the ‘Chaos Stone’ tab can be purchased in large amounts.

■ Ranking
- After the update, the ‘Check Ranking Reward’ icon will be displayed in all Ranking categories in Recruitment Board > Ranking.
- The amount of ‘Gemstone of Merit’ that is given as Ranking Rewards will be significantly increased.
Please see below for the affected Rankings.
  └ EXP Ranking / Training Arena Ranking / Chaos Mission Ranking / Spire of Barrier Individual Ranking / Void Rift Ranking

■ Chaos Stones
- The Chaos Stone selection screen will be improved.
- An info button for each Chaos Stone category will be added.
  └ Through the info button, users will be able to view the effects and benefits of each Chaos Stone category.

■ Tooltips
- The buff tooltips for ‘Weaken Totem’ and ‘Weaken DMG Totem’ will be changed as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/541fe335bddd400c1d35eb47c269cdfe8edbc9ef.png[/img]

- The tooltip for ‘Judgment of Light’ will be made clearer as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fe9ab450ea75b12c0b1af778a187b33928a01b25.png[/img]

■ Inventory
- Improvements will be made so that the max possible combine amount will be set and shown when combining materials in your Bag.

■ Skill Runes
- Changes will be made so that depending on the level growth of ‘Arctic Shard’, the basic Area of Effect increases.

■ Link Runes
- ‘Strike’ will be added to the link conditions for ‘Knockback’.
- The names of the following ‘Pierce Wound’ options will be changed:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6d0e1334b4d8945f3ea88aa3bb249b35a940f0ed.png[/img]

■ Stats
- The ‘20% chance to recover % of Max HP when hit’ option will be displayed to one decimal place so that it is the same as the option’s range values.

■ Artifacts
- Among the options of the ‘Wheel of Succession’ Artifact item, the display of the ‘Max Attack Seal Activation Count’ option will be changed.
 : 'Max Attack Seal Activation Count 1' → 'Max Attack Seal Activation Count +1'

■ Alchemy
- The explanations on the Alchemy > Transfer screen will be made clearer.
- After the update, you will be able to do multiple Alchemies with one Alchemy Desk when doing Alchemy with the 3 types of Traces of Disintegration from the Combining > Other tab.

■ Charms
- The location of the window that appears when comparing the options of equipped Charms and Charms in your Inventory will be improved.
- After the update, the costs for removing Charms will be removed, and equipped Charms will not be destroyed when switching Charms while a Charm is equipped.

■ Pets
- After the update, the ‘Gear’ tab will open as the default tab when using Pet Ability. 
- The Pet auto loot function will be improved.

■ Items
- Among Armor Suffix options, the ‘Mana Regen/Sec +%’ option will appear from Tier 1 items after the update.
- The grades of the following 4 items will be changed from ‘Normal’ to ‘Rare’:
  ● Rare Charm Chest V
  ● Rare Charm Chest Ⅵ
  ● Rare Charm Chest Ⅶ
  ● Rare Charm Chest Ⅷ

- After the update, users will be able to register the below 133 items in their General Storage:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e2238ddc46a7a4a0874a8cd1302bc1ee617d17c7.png[/img]

■ Other
- Among the CAPTCHA security phrases, some characters that are hard to distinguish will be excluded.
 └ Excluded characters: English alphabet I, O, S, Z
- An explanation about the excluded characters will be added to the CAPTCHA window. 
- The shape of some characters will be changed so that the CAPTCHA security phrases are easier to distinguish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

■ Void Rift
- Void Rift 4 will end and Void Rift 5 will begin!
Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history will be reset.
The boss monsters of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
You will not be able to receive previous rewards once the period ends, so please collect all rewards before the maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift will take place for 2 weeks.

■ Zodiac Pass
- Zodiac Pass 4 will end.
You will not be able to claim Zodiac Pass 4 rewards after the Jun. 22 (Thu) scheduled maintenance, so please claim the relevant rewards before then.
- Zodiac Pass 5 will begin!
For more details, please check the in-game ‘Event’ tab in the upper right corner of the screen.
- The Zodiac Pass period will last for 2 weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ New Products[/b]
※ These are the new products that will be added with the update.

◆ Zodiac Pass 5
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ‘Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the Jun. 22 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Jul. 6 (Thu) maintenance

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period: 
Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account, and once purchased, its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards such as [b][Exclusive] Traum’s Crystals[/b].
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current pass period, so please make sure to claim them before the period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your progress level, points, and rewards will be changed and reset.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

notes.title: Jun. 8 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will take place on Jun. 8 (Thu).

Please see below for more details.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.
※ Information on bug fixes will be released in a separate notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update
※ These are the updates, improvements, and changes that will come into place with the update.

■ Season Challenges
- The difficulty of some missions will be lowered.
- The scores needed for obtaining Season Rewards have been eased.
 ㄴ [Exclusive] Legendary Upgrade Essence: 140 → 120
 ㄴ [Season Challenge] Legendary Title Ticket: 200 → 160
 ㄴ Messenger's Headdress: 250 → 200
 ㄴ Messenger's Armor: 310 → 250

■ Serpens Statue
- When a Serpens Statue event occurs with a Magic Chaos Card, a chance of Abyssal Fissure portals appearing will be imbued.
- The chance of Serpens Statue portals appearing with Rare/Legendary Chaos Cards will increase by 3 times compared to before.

■ Runestones
- The way some Runestones can be obtained will change. Please see below for the changes.

[b]Runestones from Cleared Descent Raids[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0375fa042c375bde74b165d8e54a3ee1a11f3e52.png[/img]

※ Magic and Rare Runestones that are obtained from Descent Raids can also be obtained through Alchemy > Synthesis.

[b]Runestones Exclusive to Synthesis[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/c8608c35e2b8d1d12436ef7254a7adb6b705a376.png[/img]

※ Among the 3 Runestones used as materials, the Runestone with the highest level must meet the required level outlined in the table above before the relevant Runestone can be obtained.

■ Tooltips
- The tooltip for ‘Random Upgrade Essence’ will be changed.
- The tooltip for ‘Quick Slash’ Skill Rune Awakening (Verity) will be changed as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fffeefed0a9dcd8328ccf40dff6c413098ae59bc.png[/img]

■ Storage
- Some items will be added to the [Exclusive] Rune, Charm Essence Storage slots, and some sorting orders will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0b4cfa7ba278a3c6f07527490f2fc757273ac300.png[/img]

■ Alchemy
- A new Combining formula will be added to the Alchemy ‘Combining > Essence Piece‘ tab.
  * [Exclusive] Charm Legendary Upgrade Essence Piece

■ Charms
- Improvements will be made so that Charms obtained through drops are also tradable.

■ UI
- Changes will be made so that the 3 types of Trading Keys sold at the Paid Shop can be more clearly distinguished.

■ Rankings
- The description of the necessary requirements for registering for ‘[Season] Auction House Highest Price Ranking’ will be made clearer.

■ Other
- Some of the explanations on the game loading screen that are confusing will be edited.

■ Void Rift
- Void Rift 3 will end and Void Rift 4 will begin!
Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history will be reset.
The boss monsters of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
You will not be able to receive previous rewards once the period ends, so please collect all rewards before the maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift will take place for 2 weeks.
- The difficulty of some bosses that use Summon Skills in Void Rifts will be lowered.

■ Zodiac Pass
- Zodiac Pass 3 will end.
You will not be able to claim Zodiac Pass 3 rewards after the Jun. 8 (Thu) scheduled maintenance, so please claim the relevant rewards before then.
- Zodiac Pass 4 will begin!
For more details, please check the in-game ‘Event’ tab in the upper right corner of the screen.
- The Zodiac Pass period will last for 2 weeks.


[b]◈ New Products[/b]
※ These are the new products that will be added with the update.

◆ Zodiac Pass 4
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from 'Event' in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the Jun. 8 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Jun. 22 (Thu) maintenance

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period:
Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once. 
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account, and once purchased, its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards such as [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stones.
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current pass period, so please make sure to claim them before the period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your progress level, points, and rewards will be changed and reset.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.

notes.title: Director’s Letter Vol. 4 (Edited on 6/13 13:30 UTC+9)
notes.content:
[b]Hello, I’m Ryu Myung-Sang, UNDECEMBER’s director.[/b]

About a month has passed since the start of UNDECEMBER’s first Season Mode and globally integrated service.

Due to the significant changes introduced by the update, the UNDECEMBER service was temporarily unstable when the update first came into place.
To help stabilize the game, our development and operations teams have been working on updates for the past month, with a particular focus on game stability and bug fixes. 
We are working hard to quickly resolve remaining issues, and although there are still many areas that need work, we are prioritizing the stabilization of our service so that Rune Hunters can play the game in a stable environment.

Many Rune Hunters have expressed their interest and support since the introduction of Season Mode.
We would like to thank you for your generous encouragement and for your opinions on how we can make the game better. 
Our development team also had concerns about introducing Season Mode, but as mentioned in my previous letter, it is one of the cornerstones for ensuring that UNDECEMBER continues to stay by Rune Hunters for a long time in the future.
Fortunately, we have received many positive responses since the Season Mode update, and it is now establishing itself as a central part of the game. 

In today’s letter, I will focus on the improvements that will be made based on user opinions, as well as some key information on the new modes that will be introduced in Season 2.
There’s also information about a small event in the middle of the letter, so even though it may seem long, please take the time to read through it carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]1) Improvements to Auction House and Combined Trading Post[/b]
With the Season Mode update, items that can be traded at the Auction House were increased and a Combined Trading Post for global trading was opened.
In line with this, features for improving the convenience of trading were also added. But when we checked user trends, we found that many users found the waiting time for receiving Rubies the most inconvenient.
Although we deeply empathize with this, we ask for your understanding as this feature was added as a measure against illegitimate Ruby transactions, and therefore, the waiting time cannot be immediately reduced at this point in time.

I would like to describe the improvements we are preparing to minimize the inconveniences experienced when using the Auction House/Trading Post. 
The currency that is used for trading in UNDECEMBER’s Auction House is the Ruby. 
There are two types of Rubies – Paid Rubies, which are obtained with Diamonds bought through in-app payments, and Free Rubies, which can be received through Auction House trade. 
In the future, as Paid Rubies are the ones affected by illegitimate transactions, we will be making changes so that the waiting time for Rubies will only be applied to Paid Rubies. 
Since more than 80% of Rubies used in trading are Free Rubies, we hope that this improvement will significantly reduce the inconvenience experienced by users.
This change will be made immediately with the update in mid-June.

In addition, we are planning on improving the convenience of the Auction House search functions for Season 2.
For example, we will be adding a function that will allow users to search for items and option conditions directly from item tooltips.
By linking features from the Item Compendium, Alchemy, and user gear details, Rune Hunters will be able to find the items they want more easily.

[b]2) Season Mode’s Episode Progress[/b]
We also found that users wanted a feature that would allow them to quickly skim through episodes and quests in Season Mode.
One of the aims of Season Mode is to allow users to start from the beginning together, but with the progress rate being in accordance with the fact that scenarios are of great importance in the game, we understand why users may find playing through the game’s stories again repetitive.

With new Acts to be added in the future, users may hesitate to start the long journey all over again every new season.
Therefore, we plan to reduce the initial stages to 30% so that the first section can be completed more quickly.
We are aiming to apply this change from Season 2. 
Moreover, we are considering various ways of speeding up users’ progress through stories that have already been completed, such as a skip function. 
We will review various options from all angles so that we can increase the speed of the game in a way that aligns with UNDECEMBER’s vision.

[b]3) Item Drop Rates[/b]
Some users have expressed concerns that item drop rates seemed to have changed after the Apr. 27 update and more recently, but we would like to reassure users that this is not the case.
Item drop rates have remained the same since the update until now, and in fact, the drop rates of some items have been increased during maintenance and updates. 
Although there were some bugs that meant items appeared differently or did not appear at all, these issues have now been resolved.
It is our policy not to proceed with patches that alter item drop rates without informing users first through our official community, and we promise that this will not change.
For Season 2, we are working on making it easier for users to view item information more accurately, including information on sources and drop rates for key items, so please look forward to that.

[b]4) Skill Skins[/b]
‘Skill Skins’ were added as a new Beauty item after the Apr. 27 update, and users have expressed a desire to see skins for skills that do not have them yet.
The skill skin equip rate has been steadily increasing, and as a new fun element that users seem to be enjoying, we will continue to update them in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/4210d20d21a51c183c57ee44853c3f5821c7b0ac.png[/img]
For those who use skills that do not have any skill skins at the moment, we have prepared a surprise event!
Vote for the skill skin you wish to see in the next Season with the voting link below!
The skill skin with the most votes will be added first in the next Season update. 

👉 [b][url=https://forms.gle/r3CLZ8ahkhe24BTXA]Vote for a Skill Skin![/url][/b]

[b]5) Crusade of Glory[/b]
We have received many inquiries about when the PVP content ‘Crusade of Glory’, which was scheduled in pre-update plans, will be opening.
With the balance for Crusade of Glory being so important, we are currently focused on internal tests, and will be releasing a pre-season version with the update in July. (Edited on 6/13 13:30 UTC+9)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e82a13e45538ad9c3e3244c19f39139bb78d76cc.gif[/img]
Below is an overview of the changes that will be in effect for the Crusade of Glory pre-season:
	- Battles will be changed from free-for-all to team battles. Accordingly, the roles of characters will be important, and strategic battles between teams will be required. 
	- The received damage decrease in the current game’s balance will not be applied, and instead, a PVP-exclusive balance will be applied. The skills that can be used will also be limited to PVP-exclusive skills. This decision was deliberately made for the sake of balance as some skills are not suitable for PVP. We will continue to adjust the balance through future patches so that more skills can be used.
- There will be grades and rankings, and according to these, there will be exciting rewards provided every week to help further motivate users to participate (the grades for pre-season may be fixed). After testing the content’s balance through the pre-season during Season 1, we are aiming to release the official version for Season 2, so please look forward to that. 

Finally, I would like to talk a little about UNDECEMBER’s Season 2, which is currently being developed.
For this next Season, we are aiming to make users’ Season play even more special. 

[b]* Hardcore Mode and Origin Mode[/b]
As partly revealed on the previous update page and Director’s Commentary video, Hardcore Mode and Origin Mode will be added to the next Season. 

Hardcore Mode is a mode where users can no longer play content when their characters die.
As we are aware that not dying in UNDECEMBER is extremely difficult, special buffs and impressive rewards exclusive to Hardcore Mode will be provided, and these rewards will be available to trade at the Trading Post regardless of mode. 
Moreover, as a compensatory measure for content where it is impossible for characters not to die, users will not receive death penalties for special content such as Void Rift, Raids, and Spire of Barrier.
Even if you cannot play content due to death, you will still be able to log in to the game with your character, so you can still carry out activities such as changing Guild Masters, and retry content by moving equipped items to other characters.

Origin Mode is a mode where the use of some Essences is restricted.
Since the use of Essences is restricted, the mode maximizes the fun of combat and farming as most items are obtained from drops.
In Origin Mode, tiers of drop items will be adjusted so that they match the difficulty of obtaining them.
Users will be able to enjoy a more rewarding experience when obtaining new and amazing items, such as Legendary gear drops.

Moreover, the new Act 13 Hira region will be added to Season 2, along with more than 10 new Skill/Link Runes and other improvements to convenience, such as improvements for users who use game pads.
To explain the new area briefly, the Hira region is themed around the inner world of Ilya the Zodiac Master.
With the story of Ilya, who led an unfortunate life due to the outbreak of the Zodiac War, and the systemically organized graphic concepts, users will be able to experience a more vivid and complete story. 

Please look forward to what destiny has in store for you and Canna!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

With the green leaves of summer and welcome cries of cicadas fast approaching, we wish you happiness and health as we await the summer.

Thank you for your unwavering support.

[b]Ryu Myung-Sang.[/b]

- The issue where damage received by the wearer was also affected when items with DoT options were equipped has been fixed.
- The issue where the Enhance effect from the ‘Melee’ tag was not applied when using the Lightning Wave skill has been fixed.
- The issue where [Exclusive] Traum’s Crystal Pieces in Storage could not be used as Combining materials has been fixed.
- The description for ‘The Nicknamed‘ Title has been edited.

notes.title: May. 25 Update (6/1 15:20 (UTC+9) Edited)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will take place on May. 25 (Thu).

Please see below for more details. 

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.


[b]◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update[/b]
※ These are the updates, improvements, and changes that will come into place with the update.

■ Descent Raids
- A new FLOOR website community board for the game’s periodic Descent Raid content will be established. 
　└  For details on Raid schedules and modes,
        please check the notices on the UNDECEMBER FLOOR website > ‘Content Schedule’ board.
The schedule for Descent Raids that will take place before the start of Season 2 will be announced on this board.
       [url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1684840347193025906][Go to Content Schedule Board][/url]
- The difficulty of Descent Raid modes will be partially adjusted. 
- After the update, users will not be able to enter Descent Raids if their Bag is full.
  ※ Please ensure you have enough space in your Bag before entering the Raids.

■ Chaos Dungeons
- Adjustments will be made so that the following items are dropped in Chaos Dungeons.
  * Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece / Monster Lv. 144 or higher
  * Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece / Monster Lv. 142 or higher

■ Stage Events
- The duration of the ‘Blessed One‘ buff, which is received when Altar of Blessing is activated,
  will be changed from 60 seconds → 100 seconds.
  * As before, the ‘Blessed One’ buff will disappear upon death,
    and if you have no related buff, you will not be able to find Realm Rifts.
- Once 100 seconds pass after activating the Altar of Blessing,
  all Realm Rifts and monsters created by the event will disappear.

■ Void Rift
- Void Rift 2 will end and Void Rift 3 will begin!
  Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history will be reset.
  The boss monsters of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
  You will not be able to receive previous rewards once the period ends,
  so please collect all rewards before the maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift will take place for 2 weeks.
- The difficulty of some bosses that use Summon Skills in Void Rifts will be lowered.

■ Constellation of Time
- The confusing Constellation of Time Memory ‘Amplify Element’ display will be deleted. 

■ Black Market 
- The following items will no longer be sold at the Black Market.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a807df26a1b2ce9004d88a869d1f960f412be963.png[/img]

■ Alchemy
- The icon for the Alchemy Mastery Trait ‘Master of Bargaining Ⅲ’ will change.
- New Combining formulas will be added to the Alchemy Combining tab.
　* [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece
　* [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece
- The sources of the Runes below will change.
　└ Buff Activation upon using Movement Skill, Opportunistic Strike 
　※ Source: Chaos Mission → Synthesis
　※ The above 2 Link Runes can be obtained from Magic Synthesis Link Rune Selection Chests /
        Rare Synthesis Link Rune Selection Chests / Improved Magic Link Rune Selection Chests /
        Improved Rare Link Rune Selection Chests.

■ Ore Shop
- The items below will be sold from the Gemstones of Merit Shop.
   * [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece
   * [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece

	
■ Tooltips
- The descriptions for some Skill Runes will be changed as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b1904c9ced17cc7b9cd62688b58b559b498d8ac4.png[/img]

- For the ‘Wheel Slash (Verity)’ Skill Rune tooltip, the ‘Skill Buff Stack Count +n’ phrase will be changed to ‘Max DoT Stacks +n'.
   └ The actual effect will be the same as before.

■ Compendium
- With the changes in sources for some Runes, the information that can be viewed
  through the ‘Rune Compendium – Source’ filter will change.

■ Titles
- The phrase ‘Account Title’ will be deleted from some descriptions related to Titles.

■ Items
- The ‘Minion Block Expertise +’ and ‘Sentry Block Expertise +’ options from the Minion/Sentry Belt options
  will be changed to appear from Tier 1.
- The drop chance of Traces of Creation obtained from Memory Rune events will be significantly increased.
- Among the Auction House keywords for the Unique Item ‘Ortemis' Rejuvenation’,
  the following will be changed to match the actual Unique option.
　└ On hit/Additional Element DMG → Per Accumulated Overheat/% HP Regen per Sec

■ Sealed Runes
- New Sealed Runes will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/396fe67ce79f0e68052d037f94922165e4269906.png[/img]

■ Storage
- The following item slots will be added to the Exclusive Essence Storage:
  [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece
  [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece
  [Exclusive] Runestone Magic Link Essence Piece
  [Exclusive] Runestone Rare Link Essence Piece

■ Skill Rune
- The control feedback for the ‘Deadly Poison Skewer’ skill will be improved. 

■ Crafting
- The max for the Totem Duration +% crafting option Totem Effect +% tier appearance will be adjusted.
   * Before: 7, 10 
   * After: 7, 10, 12

■ Zodiac Pass
- Zodiac Pass 2 will end.
  You will not be able to claim Zodiac Pass 2 rewards after the May. 25 (Thu) scheduled maintenance,
 so please claim the relevant rewards before then.
- Zodiac Pass 3 will begin!
  For more details, please check the in-game ‘Event’ tab in the upper right corner of the screen.
- The Zodiac Pass period will last for 2 weeks.

■ Runestones
- When obtaining Runestones through drops in Descent Raids or with Alchemy Synthesis,
  the minimum obtained level for each Runestone will be adjusted as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7ba74cac44d2eda4666fa097815dbcd8a989f08b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0ae33fff8954ca51ed8ee8fd066be0094addcd84.png[/img]

[strike]■ Charms
- The probability of obtaining a higher tier than before for Charm tiers that are obtained from Charm Synthesis will be partially increased.[/strike] (05/25 13:55 (UTC+9) Edited)

[b]■ Other[/b]
- The UI will be improved to enhance the visibility of the grade category button within the sell and disassemble screens. (05/26 18:20 (UTC+9) Added)


[b]◈ New Products[/b]
※ These are the new products that will be added with the update. 

◆ Zodiac Pass 3
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ’Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the May. 25 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Jun. 8 (Thu) maintenance

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period:
  Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account, and once purchased,
  its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
  This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode. 
  E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
  Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards in addition to Normal Rewards
  when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards such as [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stones.
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current pass period,
  so please make sure to claim them before the period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your progress level, points, and rewards will be changed and reset.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.


[b]◈ Bug Fixes[/b]
※ These are the bug fixes that will take place with the update.

■ Runestones
- The issue where incorrect Runestone levels are obtained when synthesizing Runestones through Alchemy will be fixed.

■ Chaos Dungeons
- The issue where Legion of Evil grade monsters do not immediately spawn in Dungeons
  created with upgraded Chaos Cards will be fixed.
- The issue where the displayed Chaos Dungeon level and tier are different between Party Members
  when playing Chaos Dungeons in a Party will be fixed.

■ Constellation of Time
- The issue where information on Spent Emotions and Obtain Memory is not displayed in the information screen UI
  for Stage 4 of Constellation of Time will be fixed.

■ Monsters
- The issue where Crowd Control is applied on monsters summoned by Evermund will be fixed.
- The issue where the area skill effect of Subject Slaughterer is not displayed will be fixed. 

■ Black Market
- The issue where, after purchasing an item from the Black Market, the ‘Identify’ button is not displayed
  when selecting a Chaos Card of Magic grade or higher from the Chaos Statue will be fixed.

■ Party
- The issue where the notification UI for the Recruit Party category in the Chat is displayed incorrectly
  when promoting a Party will be fixed.
- The issue where Party Member icons do not disappear from the minimap when members leave the Party will be fixed.
 
■ Guild
- The issue where in certain circumstances, the Guild Master is not included in the number of people logged in will be fixed.
- The issue where only the Guild Master cannot use Guild buffs in certain circumstances will be fixed.
[strike]- The issue where the Guild Master promotion cooldown is applied incorrectly will be fixed. [/strike]
※ This issue will be fixed during the Jun. 8 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.
    We will notify you through a notice if this schedule changes.

■ Recruitment Board
- The issue where the notification UI for the Recruitment Board continues to be displayed
  even after claiming all rewards will be fixed.

■ Mailbox
- The issue where, when claiming Currency items from mail, Currency cannot be received through ‘Receive All’
  when inventory is full will be fixed.
- The issue where received mail cannot be checked in the mailbox will be fixed.

■ Item Compendium
- The issue where users cannot register the ‘Maximized DMG Increase’ Link Rune in their Item Compendium
  with Standard Mode characters in certain circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where certain gear items cannot be registered in Item Compendium - Unique Compendium will be fixed.

■ Chaos Compendium
- The issue where Chaos Compendium progress does not increase beyond a certain score will be fixed.

■ Tooltips
- The issue where the phrase, ‘Cannot link Parallel Multishot Link Rune’, is missing from the tooltip
  for the ‘Toxic Flame (Verity)’ Skill Rune will be fixed. 
  └ The actual effect will be the same as before.

■ Paid Shop
- The issue where products related to Storage are sometimes displayed in the Paid Shop
  despite having already been purchased will be fixed.

■ Inventory
- The issue where Descent Raid rewards cannot be claimed when Inventory is full will be fixed.

■ Items
- The issue where the ‘Chance to gain Pulverize for 3 s on hit’ option of some items is not applied will be fixed.
- The issue where options are not added when trying to enchant a certain item
  with a Rare Imbue Essence in its 6th slot will be fixed.

■ Trading Keys
- The issue where, despite changing an item to tradable with a Trading Key,
  the Trading Key is displayed in the Bag and can be registered for use will be fixed.

■ Crafting
- The issue where items imbued with a certain option before the Apr. 27 (Thu) update cannot be crafted will be fixed. 
　└ Affected option: DoT % Amplification

■ Skill Runes
- The issue where the cooldowns of different Totem Skill Runes are shared will be fixed.
- The issue where the Soul Gem’s Skill Rune Cooldown Recovery Speed option
  does not apply to Avatar Acuben’s Curse of Storm skill will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Chain Attack count‘ description for the ‘Quick Slash (Verity)’ skill is displayed differently
  in the tooltips for the Compendium and Rune Awakening screen will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Flamethrower’ skill effect is not displayed in certain circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Piercing’ Link Rune does not link to the Skill Runes below will be fixed.
　└ Affected Skill Runes: Shockwave Arrow / Piercing Arrow / Scorching Arrow
[strike]- The issue where the skill effect buff sometimes does not activate when using the Quick Slash (Verity) skill will be fixed. [/strike](05/24 11:15 (UTC+9) Edited)

■ Avatars
- The issue where from the passive effects of Avatar of Casthor, the ‘Enhance Sanctum Effect’ does not work properly
  on certain Sanctums will be fixed.

■ Auction House
- The issue where items that cannot be registered in the Auction House are displayed as ‘Auction Failed’
  and can be reobtained will be fixed.

■ Charm
- The issue where the results of Charm Synthesis are different than intended when spending 2 or less high tier materials will be fixed. (05/25 13:55 (UTC+9) Added)

■ Other
- The frame drop issue for Act 12 stages will be fixed. 
- The frame drop issue that occurs when entering Golden Ring Chaos Dungeons for some device models will be improved.
- The issue where the UI is incorrectly displayed for some languages when ‘Miss’ occurs during battle will be fixed.
  ※ Affected Languages: Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)



We hope that these update details will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.

Thank you.

notes.title: May. 12 Server Patch (05/19 14:13 (UTC+9) Edited)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER will be undergoing a server patch on May. 12 (Fri) to address identified issues.

Please refer to the following information for details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]May. 12 (Fri) Server Patch[/b]

[b]1. Server Patch Schedule: [/b]May. 12 (Fri) 2023, 21:30 (UTC+9)
* The server patch will proceed without maintenance.
* The game will therefore be available to play while the server patch is underway.

[b]2. Server Patch Details[/b]
- The issue where the Icy Arrow (Verity) and Fire Torrent (Origin) Skill Runes cannot be transferred or grown will be fixed.

- The issue where the buff effect of the ‘Preemptive Strike’ Link Rune does not activate in some circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where the buff effects of the ‘Preemptive Strike’ Link Rune that activate on hit also activate as DoT will be fixed.
 
- The issue where the ‘Momentum’ Link Rune cannot be obtained from Improved Magic Link Rune Selection Chests and Magic Synthesis Link Rune Selection Chests will be fixed.
   ※ If you could not select the ‘Momentum’ Link Rune from the selection chests above, please contact Support and we will help you in the order in which inquiries are submitted.
 
[strike]- The issue where the item tooltip for sealed ‘Weaken DMG Totem’ is different will be fixed.[/strike]
(05/19 14:13 (UTC+9) Edited)
 
- The issue where an error message appears when using the ‘Trading Key - Charm’ item on Chaos Stars will be fixed.
- The issue where used amounts are incorrect when using the ‘Trading Key - Charm’ item on Chaos Stars will be fixed.
   ※ For incorrect used amounts for Trading Keys that have been used previously, we will send the incorrectly used amounts during a scheduled maintenance at a later date.
 
- The issue where the summoned location of Realm Rifts in Act 12 ‘Lonely Stone Path’ is incorrect will be fixed.
