notes.title: May. 11 Update (May. 16 19:30 (UTC+9) Added)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will take place on May. 11 (Thu). 
Please see below for more details.

※ The following updates may change or be postponed when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Improvements and Other Changes
※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place with the update.

◆ Improvements and Other Changes

■ Tooltips
- The tooltip for the Deadly Poison Skewer Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0a38de8925253bf9fe2f9bf1d1dcca47f6a1b8a0.png[/img]

- The tooltip for the Deadly Poison Claw Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/346d0e9624a38313287905d8c78498a270adafec.png[/img]

- The tooltip for the Flamethrower Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/48dfce1042cd512435611274b56e07afb86f7db6.png[/img]

■ Stats
- The stat names below will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a2ad6697d7aeb908930524b7a88e71b69fe98635.png[/img]

- Detailed descriptions will be added to Link Rune tooltips, and you can check them by selecting the relevant stat in the game.
	ㄴ When Status Effects occur, the DMG that determines the effect and duration is amplified,
     so higher effect and duration values are applied. 

■ Void Rift – New Season
- The previous season of Void Rift will end, and a new season will begin!
  Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history is reset every season.
  The boss monsters of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
  You will not be able to receive the previous season’s rewards once the season ends,
  so please be sure to collect all rewards before maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift season will take place for 2 weeks.

■ Descent Raids
- The ‘Magroth’ Descent Raid will end.
- The ‘Trischema’ Descent Raid will start.
- The ‘Vilam’ Descent Raid will start on May. 18 (Thu). 
- Descent Raids take place for 2 weeks, and are followed by a 1-week reward period. 

■ Inventory
- Charms will be separated from gear in the Inventory tab.

■ Auction House
- Sealed Runes will be moved from the ‘Others’ category to the ‘Rune’ category in the Auction House. 

■ Paid Shop
- UI will be improved so users can scroll when there are 5 or more grantable items from the items for sale at the Paid Shop. 
- The purchase limit per purchase of Memory Runes and God’s Resonance Stones has been lifted.

■ Rankings
- Rankings exclusive to Seasons will be marked differently to normal rankings.

■ Map Exploration Rate
- The method for claiming rewards for map exploration rates will change from claiming for each stage → claiming all in one go.
	ㄴ The ‘Receive Reward‘ button will change to a ‘Receive All’ button,
     and when the ‘Receive All’ button is selected, all exploration rate rewards that have not yet been received will be claimed. 

■ DMG
- A differentiating DMG font feature will be added so that Maximized DMG can be seen more easily.

■ Alchemy
- The ‘Trigger Rune Change Essence’ section in the Alchemy Combining/Essence menu
  will be changed to ‘[Exclusive] Trigger Rune Change Essence’.
- Each World's Memory Tier/Grade section in the Alchemy Combining menu will be improved
  so that multiple can be crafted at the same time. 
- A section where you can combine [Exclusive] Traum’s Crystal Pieces with Traum's Crystal Pieces
  will be added to the Alchemy Combining/Other menu. 
- After the update, you will get [Exclusive] items when combining Trigger Rune Change Essences.
- After the update, you will be able to use [Exclusive] Rune Link Essences as material
   when combining Trigger Rune Change Essences.
- Costs for combining Trigger Rune Change Essences will change.
  ㄴ Before: Rune Link Essence x500, Philosopher's Stone x5
       After: Rune Link Essence x100
- After the update, items obtained in the previous Season will be available to transfer
  in gear transfer in the Alchemy Transfer menu. 
  However, they cannot be transferred with items acquired from new Seasons.

■ Chaos Dungeons 
- When playing Chaos Dungeons, ‘Rune Hunter's Resolve’,
  which allows you to obtain additional Statue EXP, will be applied.
※ 'Rune Hunter’s Resolve’ applies different values for different periods.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/669379474260409f1943dd63819e745360ffe142.png[/img]

■ Other
- Emphasized sound effects for when Crystal Orbs and Chaos Crystals are dropped will be removed.


◈ New Products
※ The following is information on the new products that will be added with the update.

◆ Zodiac Pass – Season 2
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ’Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the May. 11 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the May. 25 (Thu) maintenance 

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period:
  Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset 
- By clearing Zodiac Pass ‘missions’, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account,
  and once purchased, its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
  Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
  E.g.) Playing in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass level increases.
 Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
  in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards
  such as [Exclusive] Skill Rune Legendary Upgrade Essences.
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current season,
  so please make sure to claim them before the Pass period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ With the Zodiac Pass, progress levels, points, and rewards will be changed and reset once the season ends.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the season.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.


◈ Balance Changes
※ These are the Character, Rune, Monster, and other balance changes that will be made.

■ Drops
- The drop chance of higher-grade Earth Elements dropping for higher monster levels will be increased. 
- Among Rare Essences, the appearance chances for Rare Upgrade Essences, Rare Imbue Essences,
  Rare Expansion Essences, Charm Rare Upgrade Essences, Charm Rare Change Essences,
  Skill Rune Rare Upgrade Essences, and Link Rune Rare Upgrade Essences will be increased. 
- When Charms are dropped, the chance of Rare Charms being dropped
  and the Rare Charm change chance due to the rarity of discovered items will be significantly increased.
- Chaos Event: The drop chance of items in Chaotic Realms will be increased. 
- Chaos Event: With the Serpens Statue, the drop chance of Charm Essences from the statue
  and from the monsters summoned by the statue will be significantly increased.
- Chaos Event: With the Serpens Statue, the Elite monsters summoned by the statue
  will drop large amounts of Darkness Energy after the update.
- The amount of Normal Rune Essences dropped by Elite monsters will be increased.
- The amount of Essences dropped in Chaos Dungeons will be increased.

■ Charms
- The chance of Rare Charms appearing when synthesizing Magic Charms will be increased from 3% to 30%.
- The chance of high-tier Charms appearing when synthesizing Charms will be increased.
※ The standards for changing Tier will be based on the highest tier among registered Charms, and cannot exceed Tier 8.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/4943efefaf841c399e0c45a7ff08a5428c301996.png[/img]

■ Monsters
- The difficulty of certain skills of Four-legged Bartus will be decreased.
- The Freeze duration of Treasure Chests has increased slightly.

◈ Bug Fixes
※ These are the bug fixes that will take place with the update.

■ Storage
- Restoration for the issue where items disappeared from Storage have been completed.
	ㄴ Restored items have been sent to your in-game mail, so please check your mailbox.
	ㄴ As mail have a storage period, please make sure to claim your items within the period.
    If you do not claim the items within the period,
    please note that we may not be able to offer you additional assistance on the matter, such as sending the items again.

■ Options
- The issue where the ‘+% DMG for 3 s upon using a potion’ option for the Unique item, ‘Golden Band of Opportunity’,
  does not work when using Mana/Enhance Potions, will be fixed. 

■ Compendium
- The issue where users’ Chaos Compendium progress is reset will be fixed. 
	ㄴ Restored items have been sent to your in-game mail, so please check your mailbox.
ㄴ As mail have a storage period, please make sure to claim your items within the period.
    If you do not claim the items within the period,
    please note that we may not be able to offer you additional assistance on the matter, such as sending the items again.
- The issue where the Item Compendium Collection Effect is not applied when selecting a character will be fixed.

■ Quests
- The issue where users cannot complete the sub quest ‘Searching for Traces’ in certain circumstances will be fixed. 
　→ If you experience this issue, please complete the quest by talking to NPC ‘Robu’ in Symmesbicul.
- The issue where quest tier values are not displayed for some quests that have Chaos Dungeon tier conditions will be fixed.
- The issue where directions for navigating the quest is not displayed
  during Act 11 ‘Investigate Special Hatchery Room’ will be fixed.
 
■ Titles
- The issue where Standard character Titles change to being unowned
  when Titles are obtained with a Season character will be fixed. 
- The issue where Titles related to Achievements in Within the Storm will be fixed.

■ Tooltips
- Changes will be made so that the phrase, ‘Decrease stage every 1 s upon canceling’,
  is displayed in the Fire Torrent [Source] Awakening tooltip.

■ Runestones 
- The issue where use of Trading Keys when previewing Chest contents and when actually obtaining them
  are displayed differently will be fixed. 
- You will be able to obtain Runestones that can be registered at the Auction House through drops after the update.

■ Rune Growth
- The issue where the Rune Growth quick menu is displayed
  even when the quick menu notification has been turned off will be fixed.

■ Skill Runes
- The issue where the ‘Time of the Hunt’ Zodiac resets the cooldown time
   for the ‘Agile Movement’ and ‘Marksman’ Skill Runes will be fixed. 
- The issue where the trigger skill does not activate
  when linking the ‘Flames of Death’ Skill Rune as the target skill will be fixed. 
- The issue where the ‘Piercing’ Link Rune does not link to ‘Whirlwind Slash [Source]’ will be fixed.

■ Link Runes
- The issue where the Hit Rate bonus of the Precision Link Rune does not work properly on Awakening conditions
  when linking the ‘Precision [Origin]’ Link Rune to a Summon Skill will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Chain Impact’ Link Rune does not link to some skills that are capable of being Chained will be fixed. 
[strike]- The issue where the ‘Preemptive Strike’ Link Rune’s buff does not work properly will be fixed. [/strike]
[strike]  ㄴ This will be fixed at a later date. (May. 12 14:30 (UTC+9) Added)[/strike] (May. 12 21:38 (UTC+9) Edit Completed)
- The issue where stats sometimes decrease during battle will be fixed. (May. 11 15:55 (UTC+9) Added)

■ Items  
- The issue where the contents of the [Exclusive] Rune Link Essence Bundle
  and [Exclusive] Rune Color Essence Bundle is displayed incorrectly will be fixed. 
- The issue where the following undistributed items are displayed on the Black Market will be fixed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/cbba2db45b5926a97dc0027d0fead30ac5856a1e.png[/img]

■ Zodiacs
- The issue where incorrect text is displayed for some Zodiac Stone options will be fixed. 
- The issue where materials seem to be consumed when resetting Zodiacs before clearing Episode 2 will be fixed. 
- A confusing phrase that appears in the Zodiac Pass mission description will be corrected.
	ㄴ 	Season Mission: ‘Complete Raid Dungeon x n’ → ‘Clear Descent Raid x n’

■ Paid Shop
- The issue where the icon for the Combined Beauty Package is different to the actual product that is sent will be fixed.

■ Rankings
- The issue where Challenge EXP is refreshed even though the character has died will be fixed. 

■ Charms
- The issue where when obtaining Charms, only Affixes that match the Charm tier can be imbued will be fixed.

■ Pets
- The issue where Pets cannot automatically obtain some items will be fixed. 

■ Costumes
- The issue where Costumes purchased before the Season
  have not displayed  properly since the Apr. 27 (Thu) update will be fixed. 
 ㄴ Users will be refunded for costumes that have been purchased more than once with Rubies during the maintenance. 

■ Guild
- The issue where requests to join Season Guilds cannot be declined will be fixed. 
[strike]- The issue where Guild Master info and Guild Master Season info in Guild info is different will be fixed. [/strike]
(05/16 19:30 (UTC+9) Added)
- The issue where Guild buffs sometimes cannot be activated will be fixed. (May. 15 18:42 (UTC+9) Added) 

■ Drops
- The issue where Unique Relics do not drop with the ‘Anchorage of the Golden Ring’ Greater Chaos Card will be fixed.
- The issue where Greater Chaos Cards are not dropped properly will be fixed.

■ Constellation of Time
- The issue where Seal of Engraving can be obtained from Constellation of Time Reward Chests will be fixed.  
　ㄴ Obtained Seals of Engraving will be retrieved
        and replaced with [Exclusive] Rune Engraving Stone Selection Chests instead.
   ㄴ Season Mode : We will notify you of when this will take place with a notice when maintenance takes place at a later date.  (May. 11 15:13 (UTC+9) Added)
- The issue where Mystery Stones created in Constellation of Time stages
  are created in areas where movement is not possible will be fixed. 

■ Altar of Blessing
- The issue where icons and effects disappear when activating Realm Rifts will be fixed. 
 
■ Chaos Dungeons
- Changes will be made so that Glachi Chieftain Vir is moved to the middle
   when casting Pillar summoning patterns in Nemera Float Tier 8.

■ Spire of Barrier
- The issue where Waypoints in Town are sometimes not displayed
  when returning to Town after exiting Spire of Barrier will be fixed.

■ Sound
- The issue where ambient sounds play while on mute in Act 11 Town will be fixed. (May. 11 12:03 (UTC+9) Added)

■ Achievements
- The issue where Achievement rewards cannot be obtained
  even though the ‘Towards the Future’ quest has been cleared will be fixed. (May. 11 12:03 (UTC+9) Added)

■ Other
- The issue where actions such as movement and using skills are sometimes not possible
  after completing quests or replaying a sequence in certain environments will be fixed.
- The issue where mode information is not displayed properly when accessing the mailbox in certain ways will be fixed.
- The issue where certain refund messages appear when language is set to Korean
   but the country code is not for Korea will be fixed.
- The issue where the Casting sound for the Judgment of Light Skill Rune does not play will be fixed.
- The issue where in some environments,
  all content is locked and users cannot move after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update will be fixed.
- The issue where users cannot check received mail in their mailbox will be fixed. (May. 11 12:03 (UTC+9) Added)

We hope that these update details will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.

Thank you.

notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Maintenance has been completed and UNDECEMBER is now available to play.

Please refer to the following information for details.


May. 11 (Thu) Scheduled Maintenance Completed

1. Completed Maintenance Schedule
: May. 11 (Thu) 2023, 08:00 - 15:00 (UTC+9)

2. Maintenance Details
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1549250/announcements/detail/3705943827548945624][▶ Link to May. 11 Update Notice][/url]

3. Maintenance Compensation
: Gemstone of Courage x 3,000
* You can claim the compensation from your mailbox
after the May. 11 (Thu) maintenance until May. 11 (Thu) 23:59 (UTC+9).
*Maintenance compensation will only be sent once per account for both modes, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
 ┗ You can only claim the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode.
* Maintenance compensation can only be claimed by accounts created before the maintenance.
Compensation cannot be claimed by accounts that were created after the maintenance.
* The duration time of Pet Ability and Zodiac Walker did not decrease while maintenance was underway.

4. Additional Information
- Compensation for the following resolved issues was sent to users’ mailboxes during the maintenance.
  ㄴ Issue where the amount of Pirate Coins owned was incorrect
  ㄴ Issue where items disappeared from Storage
  ㄴ Issue where Chaos Compendium progress was reset

notes.title: May. 4 Update (May. 11 15:50 (UTC+9) Added)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will be taking place on May. 4 (Thu). 
Please see below for more details.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Improvements and Other Changes[/b]
※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place with the update. 

[b]◆ Improvements and Other Changes[/b]

[b]■ Paid Shop[/b]

- The restrictions on the sale of Memory Rune and God’s Resonance Stone products on the Chaos Stone tab will be deleted.
   In addition, adjustments will be made so that the Memory Rune Selection Chest Bundle
   and God’s Resonance Stone Selection Chest Bundle products that are on sale on the Paid Shop > Bundle tab
   will be displayed after users enter Chaos Dungeons.  

[b]■ Characters[/b]
- The location of the ‘Transfer’ button on the Select Character screen will be adjusted.

[b]■ Skill Runes[/b]
- The ‘Cannot Chain’ keyword will be added to the Quick Slash Awakening (Verity) Skill Rune.
- The timing of Fire Explosions when using the Flamethrower Skill Rune will be improved.

[b]■ Alchemy[/b]
- The conditions for unlocking Magic/Rare Charm Synthesis recipes will be changed.
※ Once you complete the ‘Begin Operation – Talk to Favina’ quest,
    you can synthesize Charm items through ‘Alchemy’ > ‘Synthesis’.

[b]■ UI[/b]
- Some text and icons of Zodiac Pass Chest contents will be changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Balance Changes[/b]
※ These are the Character, Rune, Monster, and other balance changes that will be made.

[b]◆ Items[/b]

[b]■ Traces of Creation[/b]
- The amount of Star Memory you can obtain when disassembling Traces of Creation
   will be increased by approximately 2 times. 

[b]■ Drops[/b]
- The drop chance of Traces of Creation in the Hermit's Furnace Dungeon will be increased.

[b]◆ Content[/b]

[b]■ Chaos Dungeons[/b]
- The battle difficulty of the Chaos Dungeon Tier 11 boss monster, ‘Serpens’, will be lowered. 

[b]■ Descent Raids[/b]
- The Runestone drop chance for Descent Raids of Normal Mode will be increased.
- The drop chance for Descent Raids of Hard Mode will be increased
   so that you have a 100% chance of obtaining Runestones.

[b]■ Traces of Memory[/b]
- The drop chance of Traces of Creation in Traces of Memory (Ortemis, Triah, Chaos) Dungeons will be increased. 

[b]■ Alchemy[/b]
- The following obtainable items in the Alchemy Combining > Convert menu will be changed to [Exclusive] items,
  and the amount of required materials will be reduced by 50%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b07f355ffe49562b93890f08c4bd3f53933bad10.png[/img]

- The following items will be added to the Alchemy Combining > Other menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/52019c1b70784dc005a1737d38503e55051c0e68.png[/img]

[b]■ Zodiac Pass[/b]
- For the Zodiac Pass, product phrases and resources that may cause confusion will be replaced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/412dc1757131eeeaecc59fc1945b0f638dee7b11.png[/img]

[b]■ Settings[/b]
- The list of Red/Blue/Green Elements in the Obtaining Exclusion List in the Accessibility tab will be deleted.
- Earth Elements can be set to the Obtaining Exclusion List after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Bug Fixes[/b]
※ These are the bug fixes that will take place with the update. 

[b]■ Pet[/b]
- The issue where purchased Pets are displayed as unpurchased will be fixed. (May. 4 12:00 (UTC+9) Added)

[b]■ Auction House[/b]
- The issue where Zodiac Stones cannot be sold or registered will be fixed.

[b]■ Mastery[/b]
- The issue where Enchant Mastery reset does not work properly for some Standard accounts will be fixed.
  ※ To fix this issue, the Mastery trees of Standard characters will be reset,
     and you will be able to imbue points according to level again after the patch. 

[b]■ Compendium[/b]
- The issue where Chaos Compendium progress does not increase beyond a certain score will be fixed.

[b]■ Drops[/b]
- The issue where only Traces of Creation (Weapon) are dropped in the Hermit's Furnace final reward will be fixed.
- The issue where Skill/Link Rune Engraving Stones and Traum’s Crystal/Crystal Pieces are not dropped
will be fixed.
   These items can only be obtained from boss monsters.
   Skill/Link Runes and Engraving Stones currently cannot be obtained with Pets, and can only be obtained through users’ direct control. 
- The issue where dropped Tier Stones are not immediately visible will be fixed. 
   Tier Stones currently cannot be obtained with Pets, and can only be obtained through users’ direct control.

[b]■ Event[/b]
- The issue where the time for the Total Playtime Event Reward does not reset will be fixed.

[b]■ Characters[/b]
- The issue where Character Transfer is not possible in some worlds will be fixed.

[b]■ Titles[/b]
- The issue where Titles cannot be obtained in some Standard accounts will be fixed. 
  ※ Affected Titles will be sent to users during maintenance. 

[b]■ Chat Window[/b]
- The issue where shared item info cannot be viewed in the Chat window will be fixed.
- The issue where users cannot invite other users to a Guild through the Chat window will be fixed.

[b]■ Field Events[/b]
- The issue where the Altar of Blessing event does not work properly will be fixed. 
 
[b]■ Void Rift[/b]
- The issue where Standard character rewards can be claimed with Season characters will be fixed.

[b]■ Other[/b]
- The issue where the game exits abnormally in certain circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where Challenge Rankings are not recorded properly in certain circumstances will be fixed.
   (May. 11 15:50 (UTC+9) Added)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope that these update details will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game. 

Thank you.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.

※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place with the update.

[b]◆ Other Changes[/b]

[b]✔ Temporary Suspension of Chaos Card Trading at Auction House[/b]

With the maintenance on Apr. 19 (Wed), trading of Chaos Cards and Chaos Keys through the Auction House
will become temporarily unavailable. 
Chaos Cards and Chaos Keys that have already been registered in the Auction House
will remain registered for their remaining time after being registered. 

Moreover, although Chaos Cards and Chaos Keys acquired before the Apr. 19 (Wed) maintenance will be marked as tradable,
please note that they will not be available for new Auction House registrations.  

With the Ganida update, global service integration, and the introduction of Season Mode on Apr. 27 (Thu),
the temporary suspension of Auction House trading will be lifted,
so tradable Chaos Cards acquired after the update will be available to register in the Auction House as normal.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Some Upcoming Changes with the Apr. 27 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

With the Ganida update on Apr. 27 (Thu) and the introduction of the new Season Mode,
many changes will be coming to Rune Hunters’ journeys in UNDECEMBER.

Among these, we would like to inform you in advance about the changes that will be made
with the Chaos Dungeon reset and the introduction of Season Mode, as well as the content that will be ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Ganida update on Apr. 27 (Thu), the current Chaos Statue Level will be reset. 

After the update, users will only be able to enter Saluto and use the Chaos Dungeons
once they have fully cleared the ACT 12 Ganida story. 

Chaos Cards that are acquired before the update can be used until the update. 
After the Chaos Statue is reset, users must acquire new Chaos Cards in order to use the Chaos Dungeons.

Chaos Cards that are not used before the Ganida update will be converted into event items once the update takes place
and will be available to obtain in Standard Mode.
The types of Chaos items that will be converted include
all Chaos Cards, Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and Chests that include Chaos Keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Temporary Suspension of Trade through the Auction House[/b]
Trade of Chaos Cards through the Auction House will be temporarily unavailable after the Apr. 19 (Wed) maintenance.
Chaos Cards and items that have already been registered in the current Auction House
will remain registered for their remaining time. 

The temporary suspension of Chaos Card trade through the Auction House will be lifted after the Ganida update,
so users will be able to use the Auction House normally after the maintenance on Apr. 27 (Thu).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
Relics and Zodiacs will be reset after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
Please activate your character’s Relic Avatar, reset your Divinity Points,
and reset your Zodiac Trait and Stat points once you log in to the game after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Alchemy[/b]
The Alchemy feature will be changed so that it is shared within your account after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
As all items that are being crafted through Alchemy will be deleted after the update,
please ensure that you claim items that have been completed before the maintenance.
We also recommend that you refrain from using the Alchemy feature before the maintenance.

Formula Books will also be changed so that they are shared within your account,
and all Formula Books that have been used for characters will be reset.  
After this, we will send users the same amount of ‘Formula Book Selection Chests’
as the number of Formula Books they have used for the characters in their accounts. 
E.g.) If you have used one [Formula Book] Cold DMG Orb for Character A and one for Character B, you will receive 2 chests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Crafting[/b]
Crafting Levels (Weapon/Armor/Accessory) will be deleted after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
We will send all the Star Memory and Currency that have been used for growing Crafting Levels for each item to users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Rune Awakening[/b]
With the improvements that will be made to Rune Awakening after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update,
Awakening Stones and Seals of Engraving will be deleted.
For users who own Awakening Stones, we will send them
the same amount of Engraving Stones as the amount of Awakening Stones they own. 
Moreover, as the mechanism for Awakening will be completely changing,
we will be resetting Awakening and sending users Engraving Stones according to Rune types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Items[/b]
Users will no longer be able to acquire Color Elements (Red/Green/Blue) of all grades after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update.
All owned Color Elements will be changed to Earth Elements according to their grade.
However, as the schedule for changing these items has not yet been confirmed,
we will inform you through a future notice when the changes are made.

Star Crystals will be deleted once the Chaos Compendium is renewed,
and any owned Star Crystals will be changed to Darkness Energy.
Gold that has been used for growth for the current Chaos Compendium will be sent to users after the update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Convenience Features[/b]
The method for unlocking Alchemy Brewing slots and Formula Page slots will change after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
We will send the Currency already used to unlock these slots to users. 

In addition, as the default number of spaces provided for Bags will also change,
we will send the Currency used to expand Bags to those users who have already expanded their Bags.
※ We will send Rubies to those who have used or own Bag expansion items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Pass Products[/b]
The Statue Level Up Pass I and II  will be deleted after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
If you have purchased any of these products and are progressing with the Pass,
please ensure that you claim your Pass items before the maintenance takes place.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ Please note that we will be unable to offer assistance for Alchemy/Pass items
that have not been claimed before the Apr. 27 (Thu) maintenance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
We hope the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience,
and hope that you will look forward to and support the new Ganida update and Season Mode.

Thank you.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update[/b]
※ The following information is related to the new content that will be added through the update.

[b]◆ Descent Raid - Season 7[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids is coming!
✔ You can enter the new raid through the Recruitment Board in each Act Town or in Saluto.

[b]■ Descent Raid Details[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids, Trischema and Ochogneel, is coming!
Trischema will start on Mar. 29 (Wed) and last 2 weeks, whilst Ochogneel will start on Apr. 5 (Wed) and last 2 weeks.
When the raids open, select the boss for the raid before matching and entering.
The raids’ opening times will be the same as previous raids.
- The required level for entering the Trischema and Ochogneel Descent Raids is Lv.80, and the party size is 8 players.
- Descent Raids are special raids that you can only enter at certain times during the day.
- Once the raid is available, you can challenge the boss by either creating a raid party or matching.
- You can obtain a Unique Runestone once you defeat the Descent Raid boss.
- The Runestone you can obtain from the Descent Raid is Lv.100.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/da6340b61f09a2a6dd6cb26b844056c12fdd53cb.png[/img]

[b]■ Shadow Mirror[/b]
- Collect Shadow Mirror Shards to complete the Shadow Mirror and receive rewards upon clearing the Descent Raid.
- You can still defeat the boss without completing the Shadow Mirror, but you will not be able to receive Clear Rewards.
 * Shadow Mirror Shards can be obtained from the field or through Chaos Dungeon drops.
 * You cannot obtain any more Shadow Mirror Shards once the Shadow Mirror is fully completed.

[b]■ Additional Rewards[/b]
- Defeating the Descent Raid Boss can lead to additional rewards such as DMG Rewards and Clear Rewards.
 ㄴDMG Rewards – Can be obtained depending on your highest Total DMG score from your encounters.
 ㄴClear Rewards – Can be obtained by repeatedly defeating the Descent Raid boss after completing the Shadow Mirror.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/595198cdaca663409ba598d787051cdfa65cd8e3.png[/img]

[b]■ To Note [/b]
※ Details and rewards may be subject to change.
※ Descent Raids take place through seasons (2 weeks per season, 1 week break).

[b]◆ 2023 Spring Greeting Celebration Event[/b]
- A new event, ‘Spring Greeting Celebration Event’, will begin!
- To celebrate the coming of Spring, a drop event and attendance reward event will be taking place.
 ① During the event period, you can obtain ‘Spring Greeting Chests’
     when you defeat monsters in Episodes or in Chaos Dungeons.
     You can get the chance to obtain special items, such as Traum’s Crystal, when using Spring Greeting Chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

notes.title: Ganida Update and Global Service Integration Key Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

The Ganida update will take place through the Apr. 27 (Thu) maintenance,
and the Korean server will be added to the game’s list of servers as it is integrated with our Global service. 

This notice explains in advance the major changes that will be coming after the Global service integration,
so please see the information below to avoid any inconvenience whilst playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]1. Season Mode[/b]
As explained in the Director’s Commentary video, in order to provide more variety and fun in the game,
future updates will introduce a Season Mode that will run at regular intervals. 

The introduction of this Season Mode will mean that the game will be provided with a new balance every season.
During the Season Mode period, you can choose and play the Season Mode once you create a character. 

The first Season after the Global service integration will begin with the scheduled maintenance on Apr. 27 (Thu).

Although there may be some differences in the rewards you obtain in the game if you play in Season Mode,
the game content and growth speed of characters will be the same for both Standard Mode and Season Mode. 
 

[b]2. Information on Characters [/b]
Once the first Season begins after the Global service integration on Apr. 27 (Thu),
all characters that were previously created and played with will be set as Standard Mode characters,
meaning that you will need to [b]create new characters in order to enjoy Season Mode.[/b]

Currently, the maximum number of characters that can be created is 8,
and this will not change even with the Global service integration. 

Character slots will, however, be changed so that all 8 slots can be used without purchase.
Users who have previously expanded their Character slots will be refunded with Currency
according to the number of slots they have expanded. 

There may be some cases where some Rune Hunters may have difficulties when creating Season characters,
[b]so we will be adjusting the waiting time for character deletion from the standard 3 days (72 hours) to 3 hours.[/b] 
We are also planning on adding a feature for converting Standard Mode characters to Season Mode characters.  
When changing a character’s mode, all information about the character, apart from their name and appearance, will be reset. 

However, please note that we will not be able to provide you with separate assistance, such as restoring characters,
if you accidentally delete a character or change its mode.
So please make sure you consider your decision carefully when deleting a character or changing modes. 

Season characters that are created to be used for Season Mode will be changed to ‘Normal Mode’ characters,
or in other words, Standard Mode characters, at the end of the Season.

More detailed information related to this will be released with the update on Apr. 27 (Thu).
 

[b]3.  Introduction of Combined Auction House[/b] 
After the Global service integration, a Combined Auction House,
where items from all servers can be traded, will be added to the game.

With the Combined Auction House, you will be able to trade the various items
that are registered on the Asia/America/Europe/Korea servers, regardless of the server. 

However, in the Combined Auction House, trade will only be available in the form of Buyouts. 
The Bidding system will only be available in the current Auction House. 

For example, if you register an item for sale in the Combined Auction House on the Asia server,
Bidding will not be possible and the item can only be purchased through Buyout. 

On the other hand, if you register an item for Bidding on the Europe server,
you will not be able to use the Combined Auction House and only trade the item within the Europe server.

[b]4. Item Balance Changes and Increase in Tradable Items [/b]
With the update on Apr. 27 (Thu), the overall balance of items will be adjusted.
Along with balance adjustments, the types of tradable items will also be increased.
You can find details on the types of tradable items by checking in-game item details after the update. 

[b]5. Changes to Rune Balance and Engraving Methods[/b]
With the update on Apr. 27 (Thu), the overall balance of Skill and Link Runes will be adjusted. 
As some of the content in the current Korean service and Global service are different,
some content may change according to game balance adjustments as the services are integrated.

In addition, as users expressed disappointment about the way in which random results
are currently obtained when Engraving in the game,
we are considering improving the system so that you can designate and imbue the Awakening Effects you want. 
We will work hard to enhance your positive experience of the game by improving the system
so that you can obtain results that you choose, rather than results that are randomly obtained. 

If the Engraving system is improved, current items related to Engraving and Awakening will be deleted,
 and so that they can be used within the improved system, Seal of Engraving will be given as Engraving Stone Selections Chests,
whilst Awakening Stones will be given as Engraving Stones according to each type of Skill/Link Rune. 


[b]6. Changes to Ortemis Growth Support Chest Event Period [/b]
Although the ‘Ortemis Growth Support Chest Event’ was scheduled to last until May. 31 (Wed) after the Ortemis update,
the event will now end earlier due to the Global service integration. 

The event will now last until before the scheduled maintenance on Apr. 27 (Thu),
so please be aware of this and ensure that you finish the event before it ends. 

[b]7. Changes to the Guild System[/b]
There will also be some changes made to the Guild system with this upcoming update. 

The Guild Level and users’ personal ranking level within the Guild will be deleted. 
As before, Guild Masters can level up Guild Buffs, but in relation to activating Buffs (using them),
we are considering improving the system so that each individual Guild Member can use the Buffs. 

[b]8. Zodiac Improvements[/b]
With the balance adjustments made to items and Runes, some Zodiac content may also change.
Moreover, we are looking into new features, such as features for bringing and applying another user’s Zodiac information,
and for resetting only some Zodiac Points that have already been imbued in the Zodiac menu.
If these improvements end up being applied to the game, users will be able to set and apply Zodiacs more easily.

[b]9. Changes to Alchemy & Crafting[/b]
The Alchemy system will be changed to ‘account-shared’ content,
meaning that all slots will become available to all characters on the account.
Changes will be made to Alchemy Slots so that instead of slots being expanded through the use of existing Currency,
they will be unlocked through various content, such as Achievement Rewards.
With this change in the slot expansion method, we are planning on refunding Currency that has been used to already unlock slots.  

Orb Combining and Formula Page lists will be changed from being according to each character,
to being shared within the account, and current Orb Recipes will be maintained.
However, with these lists being integrated into account-shared lists,
we are looking into giving separate rewards for cases where the Orb Recipe used for each character is duplicated. 

In addition, items that are being crafted whilst Global service integration is taking place will be deleted,
so please ensure that you finish crafting before the server maintenance for service integration. 

Moreover, as Crafting Levels will also be deleted, we will be refunding any Currency (Star Memory, Gold)
that have been used for your current Level Up to the relevant character that used it. 

[b]10. Chaos Compendium System Renewal[/b]
As the current system where Compendium Growth is done through Star Crystals will be changed,
users will no longer be able to obtain Star Crystals after the integration of our services. 

Star Crystals that are unused before service integration will be converted into Darkness Energy,
and Gold used for your current Chaos Compendium Growth will be refunded. 

[b]11. Adjustments to Required EXP for Growth Content[/b]
For most of the content that requires users to obtain EXP in order to grow,
such as Rune Growth, Characters, Relics, and Mastery, the amount of EXP required for each level will be adjusted. 

We hope that through these adjustments, users will be able to experience faster growth.

[b]12. Expansion of Default Inventory Slots[/b]
Once service integration is complete, the default number of Inventory slots will be expanded to 300.
Through this, we hope to ease any frustrating experiences that come from obtaining
a large number of items during your journey, and hope to make your adventures more convenient. 
Users who have already expanded their slots will be refunded with Currency according to the number of slots they have expanded. 

[b]13. Attendance Book Simplification[/b]
The Attendance Book system will be simplified,
and the current Monthly and New/Returning User Attendance Books will be deleted.
With this simplification, we hope to increase focus on attendance events.

Please ensure that you check and receive unclaimed rewards before service integration.

[b]14. End to Sale of Ruby Products[/b]
As part of our preparations for service integration,
the selling of some Ruby Products at the Paid Shop will be discontinued.
We will inform you of the details regarding the products that will be discontinued
through the Apr. 12 (Wed) scheduled maintenance and update notices. 

[b]15. Season Mode Zodiac Simulator [/b]
To help users experience the Zodiac changes that will be taking place with the Apr. 27 (Thu) ACT 12 ‘Ganida’ update in advance,
a preview of the Zodiac updates will be released on the Zodiac Simulator on Apr. 20 (Thu).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

In addition, the following improvements and updates will also be made. 

[b]- Improvements to Rune Growth system and simplification of Growth Material
- Expansion of Chaos Statue Levels
- Introduction of various event stages for Episode and Chaos maps   
- Changes to the seasonal cycle of some content (3 weeks > 2 weeks)
- Expansion of Mastery content to an account-shared system[/b]
 (Needs to be reset after points are given based on the character with the highest Mastery Level)
[b]- Expansion of sharing of Titles/Achievements from character to account
- Adjustments to the grade of some Materials (Quality Modifications, Traum’s Crystals, Orb Materials)
- Removal of normal raids and subdivision of Descent Raid rewards and difficulty levels[/b]

We will continue to work hard so that we can offer more diverse experiences in Traum.

Thank you.

notes.title: Mar. 8 (Wed) Update (Added on Mar. 8 (Wed) 15:45 UTC+9)
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will be taking place on Mar. 8 (Wed).
Please refer to the information below for more details.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.
※ All screenshots were taken on a test server and details are subject to change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update[/b]
※ The following information is related to the new content that will be added through the update.

[b]◆ Recruit Party Feature[/b]
   [b]A new ‘Recruit Party’ feature will be added to the Recruitment Board.[/b]
✔ You can use the new feature through the Recruitment Board in each Act Town or in Saluto.

[b]■ Recruit Party[/b]
- You can use the Recruit Party feature through the Recruitment Board.

[b]When creating a Party, you can provide information about the Party you want to recruit by setting a Party Name, Party Type, Party Objective, required level, and conditions for joining (whether or not it can be joined immediately).[/b]
- You must enter a Party Name in order to create a Party.
- The name set when creating the Party can be freely changed by the Party leader later.
- There is a 1-minute cooldown time before you can change the Party Info.
- If a Party has the ‘Instant Join’ button set to OFF, you can only join with the approval of the Party Leader.

[b]If you use the ‘Promote Party’ feature after entering your Party Info,
a Recruit Party message will be posted onto the Recruit Party Channel.[/b]
- If you click on Chat in the Recruit Party Channel, an application for joining the Party will be automatically sent.
- The Promote Party feature has a cooldown time of 10 seconds.

[b]The Party Leader can check the list of users who have requested to join through the Party Info UI.
Party Members cannot see the Join Request List.[/b]
- The Join Request List will only display up to 50 users.

[b]You can only request to join a Party if you are not already a member of another Party.[/b]
- You can request to join once every 10 seconds.
- If the Party you are trying to join has already entered Group Content, you will not be able to request joining the Party.

[b]◆ Descent Raid – Season 6[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids is coming!
✔ You can enter the new raid through the Recruitment Board in each Act Town or in Saluto.

[b]■ Descent Raid Details[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids, Sicus and Vilam, is coming!
           Sicus will start on Mar. 8 (Wed) and last 2 weeks, whilst Vilam will start on Mar. 15 (Wed) and last 2 weeks.
           When the raids open, select the boss for the raid before matching and entering.
           The raids’ opening times will be the same as previous raids.
- The required level for entering the Sicus and Vilam Descent Raids is Lv.80, and the party size is 8 players.
- Descent Raids are special raids that you can only enter at certain times during the day.
- Once the raid is available, you can challenge the boss by either creating a raid party or matching.
- You can obtain a Unique Runestone once you defeat the Descent Raid boss.
- The Runestone you can obtain from the Descent Raid is Lv.100.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fff03af049ee23bc11f271572aed3a12b4240d92.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Shadow Mirror[/b]
- Collect Shadow Mirror Shards to complete the Shadow Mirror and receive rewards upon clearing the Descent Raid.
- You can still defeat the boss without completing the Shadow Mirror, but you will not be able to receive Clear Rewards.
 * Shadow Mirror Shards can be obtained from the field or through Chaos Dungeon drops.
 * You cannot obtain any more Shadow Mirror Shards once the Shadow Mirror is fully completed.

[b]■ Additional Rewards[/b]
- Defeating the Descent Raid Boss can lead to additional rewards such as DMG Rewards and Clear Rewards.
┗ DMG Rewards – Can be obtained depending on your highest Total DMG score from your encounters.
┗ Clear Rewards – Can be obtained by repeatedly defeating the Descent Raid boss after completing the Shadow Mirror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/595198cdaca663409ba598d787051cdfa65cd8e3.png[/img]

※ Please note that the image above was taken when an event was taking place.
    The number of rewards for when an event is not taking place may be different.

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ Details and rewards may be subject to change.
※ Descent Raids take place through seasons (2 weeks per season, 1 week break).

[b]◆ Ruins Destroyer: Magroth[/b]
  Ruins Destroyer: Magroth will be appearing to challenge Rune Hunters.
  │ [i]This invasive species that came from the void has the strange power to distort its environment.[/i]
  │ [i]Protect the ruins meant for the 12 Gods from the threat of destruction.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e0c6029b0a42557f0ed21c981bf005d5f852b770.gif[/img]

[b]■ New Raid Details[/b]
- The required level for entering the raid is Lv.90 and the party size is up to 8 players.
- Ruins Destroyer: Magroth is a Physical Element Lv.120 Raid Boss.
- With this new raid, new achievements and titles will be added.
- Available rewards for clearing the raid include Gemstone of Courage and Runestone Selection Chests.
- You can enter the new raid through the Recruitment Board in each Act Town or in Saluto.
- Once you enter the raid, you will be randomly matched with other players.
  If you enter the raid as a pre-existing party, you will only need to recruit players to fill up missing spots.
- You can enter the ‘Ruins Destroyer: Magroth’ raid once,
  and the entry count will reset every week on Monday/Thursday at 09:00 (UTC+9).
- However, your entry count will only count when you have cleared the raid.
  In other words, you will be able to enter again if you fail to clear the raid.

[b]◆ Brown’s Lucky Dice Event[/b]
- A new event, ‘Brown’s Lucky Dice Event’, will begin!
- Roll Lucky Dice to earn Dice Board Rewards and Completion Rewards.
  You can also get Lucky Special Rewards through Golden Dice.
- On special days, the daily number of Lucky Dice that can be obtained will increase. 
 * For more details, please refer to the event notice that will be going up on Mar. 8 (Wed).
   Details will also be available within the game. 


[b]◆ Runestones [/b]
- 12 new Runestones will be added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/bd9d79cf841d3759dcfdf486e2e4179857641556.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/5e350a841d47b053af1c3a1baf98580d5f152b85.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ea4165b40533a0ccbea3727b955d16d0bbe1220f.png[/img]

[b]◆ Alchemy[/b]
- The following Runestone items will be added by Grade in Alchemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b72260fe4c69c94176e79be9eec097d94cc612c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/71468ff8dc3cf0ad72295f0efdbd6dff1e9d4fb1.png[/img]

[b]◆ New Costumes[/b]
[b]■ Armor/Helmet[/b]
- 2 new Armor/Helmet costumes will be added to the game.
✔ You can find the new Armor/Helmet costumes in the Beauty → Costume menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ea03d54e860718f6e08b81c991957fb381ead868.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6a4fdd7c32674bd09a1912f9affa61ef676634af.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Weapon[/b]
- 2 new Weapons will be added to the game.
✔ You can find the new Weapons in the Beauty → Costume menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/59698c6bd9cb072729b56a1211d4a6a2260cf195.jpg[/img]

[b]■ Portals and Medallions[/b]
- 1 new Portal and 1 new Medallion will be added to the game.
✔ You can find the new Portal in the Beauty → Portal menu, and the new Medallion in the Beauty → Medallion menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/64c324a68eed7b42c45eebf4faf3ffc6ca6d2404.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/43b6484084d3ce3e6740b719c9defcb391511de9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7bca19069d23e1ac61436a6cec8f083d8a18ae0e.png[/img]

[b]■ Pet[/b]
- 1 new Pet will be added to the game. 
✔ You can find the new Pet in Menu → Pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e809a10f1354f678e0784e0f07b0257aed21d440.jpg[/img]

[b]◆ New Attachments[/b]
2 new Dash Effects and 2 new Footprint Effects will be added to the game.
* You can find the new attachments in the Beauty → Attachment menu.

[b]■ Dash Effect[/b]
Dash Effects are effects that appear behind a moving character. 

- Dawn Star Shard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/1ac1ce3dc04a48e1c368dea4e8b273e1a5fd2bf0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/48a6752555268d1906894aca15585a1e3709bdd4.png[/img]

- Spectral Lightning
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/06a05b10a4f7dbf17a994fc6785b67aef7f24eaf.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8da17da19f0fa5b8b093e3f7f01d29150f087582.png[/img]

[b]■ Footprint Effects[/b]
Footprint Effects are effects that appear under the feet of a moving character. 

- Dawn Star Shard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/00f68e9c490dbe68c74224602405d29e02dbf81e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/48a6752555268d1906894aca15585a1e3709bdd4.png[/img]

- Spectral Lightning
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/675c061cd3d1494d1ca7e552c452c31927114689.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8da17da19f0fa5b8b093e3f7f01d29150f087582.png[/img]

[b]◆ New Achievements and Titles[/b]
✔ Go to ‘Journal’ in Menu to see the different Achievements and Titles that are available.
- 1 new Achievement will be added to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f233e923a464ecfda6cbe3ee18bb67b93d52e8b9.png[/img]

- 1 new Title will be added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d451af3fc1520e25520f4508e6251cae38738e10.png[/img]

[b]◆ New Products
■ Packages[/b]
- Star Memory Package
- Memory Rune Package
- High Crafting Package
* Please check the game’s Paid Shop for more details on the packages’ sales period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Improvements and Other Changes[/b]
※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place along with the update.

[b]◆ Improvements
✔ UI[/b]
- The convenience of the Charm UI will be improved. 
  ㄴ A direction icon will be added to the Charm icon. 
  ㄴ When selecting a Charm from your Inventory, the increase/decrease in Blessing Value
       and the additional effects that are applied when the selected Charm is equipped will be displayed more clearly. 
- Improvements will be made so that the aspect ratio on some Android devices is displayed properly.

[b]✔ Materials[/b]
- The accumulated stat stack count of Darkness Energy will be increased from 100 to 9999.

[b]✔ Training Arena[/b]
■ The following features will be added to the Training Arena.
  - A feature for setting test enemies
   ※ You will only be able to set some monsters.
 - A feature for checking the distance to the enemy

[b]◆ Other Changes
✔ Void Rift – Season 8[/b]
- The previous season of Void Rift will end, and a new season will begin!
- Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history will reset every season.
- The boss monsters and levels of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
- You will not be able to receive the previous season’s rewards once the season ends,
   so please be sure to collect all rewards before maintenance takes place.
- The Void Rift season will take place for 3 weeks.
 
[b]✔ Rune Hunter Pass – Season 8[/b]
- Rune Hunter Pass Season 7 will end, and a new season will begin!
Players can complete missions and obtain rewards up until the season ends.
Rewards can no longer be obtained once the season ends.
If you have any activated rewards, please collect them before the end of the season.
※ Please check the game for more details when the season begins.

[b]✔ Chaos Ticket Exchange Event[/b]
- The Chaos Ticket Exchange Event will be ending.
※ Please note that once you access the game after the Mar. 8 (Wed) maintenance,
     your Chaos Cards will not be automatically converted into Chaos Tickets.
※ You will not be able to exchange Chaos Tickets once the event ends after the Mar. 8 (Wed) maintenance,
     so please make sure that you use the tickets before then. Unused Chaos Tickets will be deleted.

[b]✔ Valentine's Day Package[/b]
- The Valentine’s Day Package will no longer be available to purchase after the Mar. 8 (Wed) maintenance. 

[b]◆ Bug Fixes
✔ Void Rift[/b]
- The issue where the boss monster Inqubo becomes connected through effects
   to a monster that it does not summon, will be fixed. 

[b]✔ Link Runes[/b]
- The issue where the Armor Penetration Grade Effect is not applied for DoT Increase will be fixed.
- Changes have been made to the Slaughter (Truth) effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a996e0c07bb93d4d1d9c1bd879189d1cbfb009c4.png[/img]

[b]✔ Skills[/b]
- The issue where damage is sometimes only applied once instead of 2 times when doing combo skill hits will be fixed.
- The issue where some skill videos do not play will be fixed.
- The issue where certain Avatar’s Active Skill (Earth Shock) does not hit will be fixed.

[b]✔ Items[/b]
- Changes will be made so that the Chest items below can be stored in the Warehouse.
  ※ Improved Magic Skill Rune Selection Chest, Improved Magic Link Rune Selection Chest
- The descriptions for certain options of the ‘Fingers of Life and Death’ item will be corrected.
* Affected Languages: German/French/Russian/Spanish/Portuguese
- The issue where the ‘+10 DMG Skill Rune Level when Character Level is 70 or less’ option of the Unique 'Companion’s Ring'
  shows as if it has been applied twice in certain situations, will be fixed.

[b]✔ Tooltips[/b]
- The issue where cards show as being available for Auction
   when checking the card tooltip in the [Exclusive] Unique Chaos Card Selection Chest will be fixed.
- For the tooltips for Sentries and Abysslings that use Projectiles, the missing tag, ‘Cannot use Parallel Shot’, will be added.
- The phrase, ‘Is not applied if Abyssling explodes or is dismissed’ will be added to the tooltip for the ‘Shadow's Portrait’ item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/baadafec0b3ebae456fd841acd0f6aae4bdc0f42.png[/img]

[b]✔ Other[/b]
- The issue where Avatar Curse skills are displayed on the floor when applied to some monsters will be fixed.
- The issue where players spawn into the Chaos Dungeons when reconnecting to the Select World screen
  after clearing a Chaos Dungeon and returning to Saluto, will be fixed. 
- The issue where some languages are not displayed properly
   when attempting to continuously enchant Charm Tier Change Essences will be fixed. 
- The issue where some text is hidden when looking at the Alchemy guide page in certain languages will be fixed.
- The issue where effects remain in Gear Slots after Normal Crafting will be fixed.
- The issue where identification results are not reflected when identifying registered Cards during Card Growth will be fixed.
- The issue where monster hits are not possible in the ‘Choice and Conflict’ Quest will be fixed. (Added on Mar. 8 (Wed) 15:50 UTC+9)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope you are looking forward to these updates and continue to enjoy your journey in UNDECEMBER.

Thank you.

notes.title: Feb. 15 (Wed) Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will be taking place on Feb. 15 (Wed).
Please refer to the information below for more details.

※ The following information may change when the update takes place.
※ All screenshots were taken on a test server and details are subject to change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ UNDECEMBER Key Update[/b]
※ The following information is related to the new content that will be added through the update.

[b]◆ Descent Raid – Season 5[/b]
- A [b]new season[/b] of Descent Raids is coming!
✔ You can enter the new raid through each Act Town or the [b]Recruitment Board[/b] in Saluto.

[b]■ Descent Raid Details[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids, [b]Ochogneel[/b] and [b]Carovan[/b], is coming!
[b]Ochogneel[/b] will start on Feb. 15 (Wed) and last 2 weeks, whilst [b]Carovan[/b] will start on Feb. 22 (Wed) and last 2 weeks.
When the raids open, select the boss for the raid before matching and entering.
             The raids’ opening times will be the same as previous raids.
- The required level for entering the Ochogneel and Carovan Descent Raids is [b]Lv.80[/b], and the party size is 8 players.
- Descent Raids are special raids that you can only enter [u]at certain times during the day[/u].
- Once the raid is available, you can challenge the boss by either creating a raid party or matching.
- You can obtain a Unique Runestone once you defeat the Descent Raid boss.
- The Runestone you can obtain from the Descent Raid is Lv.100.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/5f840b9c97b175ff96b84ef18c902163e91be08d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8809b81556970fca84dfd60e36b18fc27aa543e1.png[/img]

[b]■ Shadow Mirror[/b]
- Collect Shadow Mirror Shards to complete the Shadow Mirror and receive rewards upon clearing the Descent Raid.
- You can still defeat the boss without completing the Shadow Mirror, but you will not be able to receive Clear Rewards.
   * Shadow Mirror Shards can be obtained from the field or through Chaos Dungeon drops.
   * You cannot obtain any more Shadow Mirror Shards once the Shadow Mirror is fully completed.

[b]■ Additional Rewards[/b]
- Defeating the Descent Raid Boss can lead to additional rewards such as [b]DMG Rewards[/b] and [b]Clear Rewards[/b].
┗ DMG Rewards – Can be obtained depending on your highest Total DMG score from your encounters.
┗ Clear Rewards – Can be obtained by repeatedly defeating the Descent Raid boss after completing the Shadow Mirror.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/45ad4978b12f820978e19543acf17ef6eb70149f.png[/img]
※ Please note that the image above was taken when an event was taking place.
    The number of rewards for when an event is not taking place may be different. 

[b]■ To Note[/b]
※ Details and rewards may be subject to change.
※ Descent Raids take place through seasons (2 weeks per season, 1 week break).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Improvements and Other Changes[/b]
※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place along with the update.

[b]◆ Other Changes[/b]
[b]■ Void Rift – Season 7[/b]
- The previous season of Void Rift will end, and a new season will begin!
- Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history will be reset every season.
- The boss monsters and levels of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
- You will not be able to receive the previous season’s rewards once the season ends,
   so please be sure to collect all rewards before maintenance takes place.
- The Void Rift season will take place for 3 weeks.

[b]■ Rune Hunter Pass – Season 7[/b]
- Rune Hunter Pass Season 6 will end, and a new season will begin!
   Players can complete missions and obtain rewards up until maintenance begins.
   Rewards can no longer be obtained once maintenance is complete. 
   If you have any highlighted rewards, please collect them before maintenance takes place.
   ※ Please check the game for more details when the season begins.

[b]■ New Items Added to Existing Chests[/b]
- Tier 31 Unique Gear will be added to Unique Weapon Chests, Unique Armor Chests, and Unique Accessory Chests.
- 2 types of Unique Chaos Cards will be added to the [Guild] Chaos Card Chest.

[b]■ Changes to Rewards due to End of Event[/b]
- The Ortemis Update 1+1 Event will be ending.
   With the end of the event, the number of rewards you can receive for various game content
   will go back to the number available from before the event.
   ※ Please refer to our other event notices for more details on the other events that will be ending.

[b]◆ Bug Fixes[/b]
[b]✔ Void Rift[/b]
- The issue where the 3 stages of Void Rift Level 12 could not be cleared in some environments will be fixed.

[b]✔ Items[/b]
- To match the phrase, ‘on hit’, changes will be made to the Unique Items below so that each skill is only triggered once.
   ※ Buffs with Cooldown times will no longer have Cooldown times and will instead depend on each skill being triggered.
   ※  Affected Items: Watcher’s Stick, Blizzard of Light, Firm Heart, Staff of Ambition, Chasing Trajectory, Alyssa's Transcendence
- The description of Night Slaughterhouse’s effects will be changed from ‘on hit’ to the more accurate expression, ‘every hit’.

- The description of Leech Tail’s effects will be edited to be more accurate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/f1f8a76a3f30bf2e4d99d3f248d62089aded25c6.jpg[/img]

- The description of Creepy Smile’s effects will be edited to be more concise.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/25e02f4dde8a17b32b3ddb194b2dd850bed8dd51.jpg[/img]

- The issue where some options of the items below were created without being attached will be fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/1b196ee9a294ba960377da151fa245241bcf742e.jpg[/img]

[b]✔ Skills[/b]
- Changes will be made so that the ‘Avoid Crisis’ buff of Shockwave Trap (Source) and Frost Trap (Verity) is not removed with DoT.
- The issue where the Pain effect of Fire Storm (Source) comes into effect even with DoT will be fixed. 
- The issue where the following buffs come into effect even with DoT will be fixed.
   ※ Affected buffs: Shockwave Trap (Origin)’s ‘Avoid Crisis’, Fire Orb Trap (Origin)’s ‘Regeneration’, and Frost Trap (Verity)’s ‘Avoid Crisis’.

[b]✔ Tooltips[/b]
- For one of the tooltips for Lightning Typhoon (Verity), 
  the phrase ‘Summon Small Lightning Typhoon’ will be changed to ‘Summon 4 Small Lightning Typhoons’.
- For one of the tooltips for Slaughter (Verity), 
  the phrase ‘Prepare Slaughter upon Boss hit’ will be changed to ‘Prepare Slaughter upon hitting an Elite Monster’.

[b]✔ Drops[/b]
- The issue where only Gear and Cards of Normal Grade are dropped from Legendary Chests of Chaos Tier 1-5, will be fixed.

[b]✔ Zodiac[/b]
- The tooltip for Zodiac (Scent) Nodes will be edited.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8ee92ec28944c7c636708e160d6f077f73859716.jpg[/img]

[b]✔ Other[/b]
- Certain phrases for the item, ‘Companion’s Ring’, will be edited.
   ※ Affected language: Chinese (Traditional)

- The issue where in the phrase ‘+50-80% DMG against enemies affected by Poison Status Effect’,
   the word ‘Poison’ is shown as ‘Chill’, will be fixed.
   ※ Affected language: Russian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope you are looking forward to these updates and continue to enjoy your journey in UNDECEMBER. 

Thank you.
